SELECT "s".fundingtype AS "funding_category", COUNT(*) AS "charter_school_count", SUM("f"."Enrollment (K-12)") AS "total_k12_enrollment", ROUND(AVG("f"."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)"::NUMERIC) * 100, 2) AS "average_frpm_percentage", ROUND(AVG(("sat".avgscrread + "sat".avgscrmath + "sat".avgscrwrite)::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_combined_sat_score" FROM "schools" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "frpm" AS "f" ON "f".cdscode = "s".cdscode AND "f"."Academic Year" = '2014-2015' LEFT JOIN "satscores" AS "sat" ON "sat".cds = "s".cdscode AND "sat".rtype = 'S' WHERE "s".statustype = 'Active' AND "s".charter = 1 AND "s".fundingtype IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded') GROUP BY "s".fundingtype ORDER BY "s".fundingtype ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "f"."County Name" AS "county_name", COUNT(*) AS "number_of_schools", ROUND(AVG(ROUND("f"."Free Meal Count (K-12)"::NUMERIC / NULLIF("f"."Enrollment (K-12)"::NUMERIC, 0) * 100, 2)), 2) AS "average_free_meal_percentage", ROUND(AVG(ROUND("f"."FRPM Count (K-12)"::NUMERIC / NULLIF("f"."Enrollment (K-12)"::NUMERIC, 0) * 100, 2)), 2) AS "average_frpm_percentage", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "f"."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1) AS "number_of_charter_schools", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "f"."Charter School (Y/N)" = 0) AS "number_of_non_charter_schools", ROUND(AVG("s".avgscrread + "s".avgscrmath + "s".avgscrwrite), 2) AS "average_sat_score" FROM "frpm" AS "f" LEFT JOIN "satscores" AS "s" ON "s".cds = "f".cdscode WHERE "f"."County Name" = (SELECT county FROM "schools" WHERE cdscode = '1612590125716') AND "f"."Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 500 AND "f"."FRPM Count (K-12)" < 700 GROUP BY "f"."County Name" LIMIT 501

SELECT (COUNT(*) / 4)::TEXT || '/3' AS "average_schools_per_month" FROM "schools" WHERE county = 'San Diego' AND doctype IN ('Elementary School District', 'High School District', 'Unified School District') AND school IS NOT NULL AND opendate >= DATE '1980-01-01' AND opendate < DATE '1981-01-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "s"."virtual" IN ('F', 'P')) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "schools" AS "s" INNER JOIN "satscores" AS "sat" ON "sat".cds = "s".cdscode WHERE "sat".rtype = 'S' AND "sat".avgscrmath > 400 LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".school AS "School name", ROUND("f"."Free Meal Count (K-12)"::NUMERIC / "f"."Enrollment (K-12)"::NUMERIC, 4) AS "Free meal rate", CASE WHEN "s".charter = 1 THEN 'Yes' WHEN "s".charter = 0 THEN 'No' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS "Charter school", "s".gsserved AS "Grades served", CASE WHEN "sat".avgscrread IS NULL OR "sat".avgscrmath IS NULL OR "sat".avgscrwrite IS NULL THEN 'No SAT Data' WHEN "sat".avgscrread + "sat".avgscrmath + "sat".avgscrwrite < 1200 THEN 'Below Average' WHEN "sat".avgscrread + "sat".avgscrmath + "sat".avgscrwrite <= 1500 THEN 'Average' ELSE 'Above Average' END AS "SAT performance level" FROM "schools" AS "s" INNER JOIN "frpm" AS "f" ON "f".cdscode = "s".cdscode LEFT JOIN "satscores" AS "sat" ON "sat".cds = "s".cdscode WHERE "s".county = 'Alameda' AND ("s".gsserved = '12' OR "s".gsserved LIKE '%-12') AND "f"."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0 AND "f"."Free Meal Count (K-12)" IS NOT NULL AND "f"."Free Meal Count (K-12)"::NUMERIC / "f"."Enrollment (K-12)"::NUMERIC = (SELECT MAX("f2"."Free Meal Count (K-12)"::NUMERIC / "f2"."Enrollment (K-12)"::NUMERIC) FROM "schools" AS "s2" INNER JOIN "frpm" AS "f2" ON "f2".cdscode = "s2".cdscode WHERE "s2".county = 'Alameda' AND ("s2".gsserved = '12' OR "s2".gsserved LIKE '%-12') AND "f2"."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0) ORDER BY "s".school ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".school AS "name", "s".phone, "s".website, "sat".avgscrread AS "average_sat_reading", "sat".avgscrmath AS "average_sat_math", "sat".avgscrwrite AS "average_sat_writing", ("s".charter = 1) AS "is_charter_school", "f"."Enrollment (K-12)" AS "enrollment_k12", ROUND(("f"."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" * 100)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "percent_eligible_frpm", (SELECT MAX("t".avgscrmath) FROM "satscores" AS "t" INNER JOIN "schools" AS "a" ON "a".cdscode = "t".cds WHERE "a".statustype = 'Active' AND "t".rtype = 'S' AND "t".numtsttakr >= 10) AS "highest_average_sat_math", (SELECT MAX("t".avgscrmath) FROM "satscores" AS "t" INNER JOIN "schools" AS "a" ON "a".cdscode = "t".cds WHERE "a".statustype = 'Active' AND "t".rtype = 'S' AND "t".numtsttakr >= 10) - "sat".avgscrmath AS "math_score_gap" FROM "schools" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "satscores" AS "sat" ON "sat".cds = "s".cdscode AND "sat".rtype = 'S' LEFT JOIN "frpm" AS "f" ON "f".cdscode = "s".cdscode AND "f"."Academic Year" = '2014-2015' WHERE "s".cdscode = '07618040113118' LIMIT 501

SELECT "ranked".county, "ranked".school_count, COALESCE("best".school, 'None') AS "school_name" FROM (SELECT "counts".county, "counts".school_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "counts".school_count DESC) AS "count_rank" FROM (SELECT county, COUNT(*) AS "school_count" FROM "schools" WHERE virtual = 'F' GROUP BY county) AS "counts") AS "ranked" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "s".county, "s".school, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s".county ORDER BY "sat".avgscrread DESC) AS "reading_rank" FROM "schools" AS "s" INNER JOIN "satscores" AS "sat" ON "sat".cds = "s".cdscode WHERE "s".virtual = 'F' AND "sat".avgscrread IS NOT NULL) AS "best" ON "best".county = "ranked".county AND "best".reading_rank = 1 WHERE "ranked".count_rank <= 5 ORDER BY "ranked".school_count DESC, "ranked".county ASC, "best".school ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "l".name FROM "league" AS "l" INNER JOIN "match" AS "m" ON "m".league_id = "l".id WHERE "m".season = '2009/2010' GROUP BY "l".id, "l".name HAVING AVG("m".home_team_goal) > AVG("m".away_team_goal) LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG("pa".ball_control) FILTER (WHERE "p".player_name = 'Abdou Diallo') - AVG("pa".ball_control) FILTER (WHERE "p".player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye') AS "mean_ball_control_difference" FROM "player" AS "p" INNER JOIN "player_attributes" AS "pa" ON "pa".player_api_id = "p".player_api_id WHERE "p".player_name IN ('Abdou Diallo', 'Aaron Appindangoye') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * ("a".overall_rating - "p".overall_rating) / NULLIF("p".overall_rating, 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM (SELECT "pa".overall_rating FROM "player_attributes" AS "pa" INNER JOIN "player" AS "pl" ON "pl".player_api_id = "pa".player_api_id WHERE "pl".player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk' ORDER BY "pa".date DESC, "pa".id DESC LIMIT 1) AS "a" CROSS JOIN (SELECT "pa".overall_rating FROM "player_attributes" AS "pa" INNER JOIN "player" AS "pl" ON "pl".player_api_id = "pa".player_api_id WHERE "pl".player_name = 'Paulin Puel' ORDER BY "pa".date DESC, "pa".id DESC LIMIT 1) AS "p" LIMIT 501

SELECT "pa".date FROM "player_attributes" AS "pa" INNER JOIN "player" AS "p" ON "p".player_api_id = "pa".player_api_id WHERE "p".player_name = 'Kevin Constant' AND "pa".crossing IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "pa".crossing DESC, "pa".date ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "pa".overall_rating > 70 THEN "p".player_api_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "p".player_api_id), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "player" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "player_attributes" AS "pa" ON "pa".player_api_id = "p".player_api_id WHERE "p".height < 180 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("p".height), 2) AS "average_height" FROM "player" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT home_player_3 FROM "match") AS "m" ON "m".home_player_3 = "p".player_api_id WHERE "p".height > 180 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rated_high) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM (SELECT "p".player_api_id, BOOL_OR("pa".defensive_work_rate = 'high') AS "rated_high" FROM "player" AS "p" INNER JOIN "player_attributes" AS "pa" ON "pa".player_api_id = "p".player_api_id WHERE "p".birthday >= '1991-01-01' AND "pa".defensive_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium', 'high') GROUP BY "p".player_api_id) AS "rated_players" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("p".match_count), 2) AS "average_matches" FROM (SELECT "a".player_api_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "match" AS "m" WHERE "m".season = '2010/2011' AND "a".player_api_id IN ("m".home_player_1, "m".home_player_2, "m".home_player_3, "m".home_player_4, "m".home_player_5, "m".home_player_6, "m".home_player_7, "m".home_player_8, "m".home_player_9, "m".home_player_10, "m".home_player_11, "m".away_player_1, "m".away_player_2, "m".away_player_3, "m".away_player_4, "m".away_player_5, "m".away_player_6, "m".away_player_7, "m".away_player_8, "m".away_player_9, "m".away_player_10, "m".away_player_11)) AS "match_count" FROM "player_attributes" AS "a" WHERE "a".date < '2011-01-01' AND "a".overall_rating > 80 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "player_attributes" AS "newer" WHERE "newer".player_api_id = "a".player_api_id AND "newer".date < '2011-01-01' AND ("newer".date > "a".date OR ("newer".date = "a".date AND "newer".id > "a".id)))) AS "p" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("p".height), 2) AS "average_height_cm" FROM "player" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ON (player_api_id) player_api_id, defensive_work_rate FROM "player_attributes" ORDER BY player_api_id ASC, date DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC) AS "current_rating" ON "current_rating".player_api_id = "p".player_api_id WHERE "current_rating".defensive_work_rate IN ('low', 'high') LIMIT 501

SELECT "t".team_short_name, COUNT(*) AS "number_of_clubs", ROUND(AVG("a".chancecreationpassing), 1) AS "average_chance_creation_passing_risk" FROM "team" AS "t" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT team_api_id FROM "team_attributes" WHERE chancecreationpassingclass = 'Risky') AS "r" ON "r".team_api_id = "t".team_api_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT team_api_id, chancecreationpassing, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY team_api_id ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC) AS "rn" FROM "team_attributes" WHERE date < '2014-09-20') AS "a" ON "a".team_api_id = "t".team_api_id AND "a".rn = 1 GROUP BY "t".team_short_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY average_chance_creation_passing_risk DESC NULLS LAST, "t".team_short_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("p".height)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_height_cm" FROM "player" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT player_api_id, defensive_work_rate, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_api_id ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC) AS "rn" FROM "player_attributes" WHERE defensive_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium', 'high')) AS "a" ON "a".player_api_id = "p".player_api_id AND "a".rn = 1 WHERE "p".birthday >= '1990-01-01' AND "p".birthday < '1996-01-01' AND "a".defensive_work_rate = 'medium' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("p".weight), 1) AS "average_weight" FROM "player" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT player_api_id FROM "player_attributes" WHERE preferred_foot = 'left') AS "pa" ON "pa".player_api_id = "p".player_api_id LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".player_name, COUNT("m".id) AS "matches_played" FROM "player" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "match" AS "m" ON "m".season = '2015/2016' AND "p".player_api_id IN ("m".home_player_1, "m".home_player_2, "m".home_player_3, "m".home_player_4, "m".home_player_5, "m".home_player_6, "m".home_player_7, "m".home_player_8, "m".home_player_9, "m".home_player_10, "m".home_player_11, "m".away_player_1, "m".away_player_2, "m".away_player_3, "m".away_player_4, "m".away_player_5, "m".away_player_6, "m".away_player_7, "m".away_player_8, "m".away_player_9, "m".away_player_10, "m".away_player_11) WHERE "p".player_name LIKE 'Adam%' AND "p".weight > 170 GROUP BY "p".id, "p".player_name LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "ta".buildupplaydribblingclass FROM "team_attributes" AS "ta" INNER JOIN "team" AS "t" ON "t".team_api_id = "ta".team_api_id INNER JOIN "match" AS "m" ON ("m".home_team_api_id = "t".team_api_id OR "m".away_team_api_id = "t".team_api_id) INNER JOIN "country" AS "c" ON "c".id = "m".country_id WHERE "t".team_short_name = 'POR' AND "c".name = 'England' AND "ta".date >= '2015-09-10' AND "ta".date < '2015-09-11' LIMIT 501

SELECT "t".team_long_name, "t".team_short_name, COUNT(*) AS "home_wins" FROM "match" AS "m" INNER JOIN "team" AS "t" ON "t".team_api_id = "m".home_team_api_id WHERE "m".home_team_goal - "m".away_team_goal >= 3 AND (SELECT "ta".buildupplayspeedclass FROM "team_attributes" AS "ta" WHERE "ta".team_api_id = "t".team_api_id AND "ta".date::TIMESTAMP <= "m".date::TIMESTAMP ORDER BY "ta".date::TIMESTAMP DESC, "ta".id DESC LIMIT 1) = 'Fast' GROUP BY "t".id, "t".team_long_name, "t".team_short_name ORDER BY home_wins DESC, "t".team_long_name ASC, "t".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".season, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".player_api_id) AS "number_of_different_players" FROM "match" AS "m" LEFT JOIN "player" AS "p" ON "p".player_api_id IN ("m".away_player_1, "m".away_player_2, "m".away_player_3, "m".away_player_4, "m".away_player_5, "m".away_player_6, "m".away_player_7, "m".away_player_8, "m".away_player_9, "m".away_player_10, "m".away_player_11) WHERE "m".home_team_goal - "m".away_team_goal >= 5 GROUP BY "m".season ORDER BY "m".season ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT name, number_of_qualifying_players FROM (SELECT "c".name, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".player_api_id) AS "number_of_qualifying_players", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT "p".player_api_id) DESC) AS "ranking" FROM "country" AS "c" INNER JOIN "match" AS "m" ON "m".country_id = "c".id INNER JOIN "player" AS "p" ON "p".player_api_id IN ("m".home_player_1, "m".home_player_2, "m".home_player_3, "m".home_player_4, "m".home_player_5, "m".home_player_6, "m".home_player_7, "m".home_player_8, "m".home_player_9, "m".home_player_10, "m".home_player_11, "m".away_player_1, "m".away_player_2, "m".away_player_3, "m".away_player_4, "m".away_player_5, "m".away_player_6, "m".away_player_7, "m".away_player_8, "m".away_player_9, "m".away_player_10, "m".away_player_11) WHERE "p".weight >= 210 GROUP BY "c".id, "c".name) AS "counts" WHERE ranking = 1 ORDER BY name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "appearances".season, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".player_api_id) AS "player_count", ROUND(AVG("p".height::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_height_cm" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "m".season, "p".player_api_id FROM "match" AS "m" INNER JOIN "country" AS "c" ON "c".id = "m".country_id INNER JOIN "player" AS "p" ON "p".player_api_id IN ("m".home_player_1, "m".home_player_2, "m".home_player_3, "m".home_player_4, "m".home_player_5, "m".home_player_6, "m".home_player_7, "m".home_player_8, "m".home_player_9, "m".home_player_10, "m".home_player_11, "m".away_player_1, "m".away_player_2, "m".away_player_3, "m".away_player_4, "m".away_player_5, "m".away_player_6, "m".away_player_7, "m".away_player_8, "m".away_player_9, "m".away_player_10, "m".away_player_11) WHERE "c".name = 'Italy' AND "m".season IN ('2008/2009', '2015/2016')) AS "appearances" INNER JOIN "player" AS "p" ON "p".player_api_id = "appearances".player_api_id GROUP BY "appearances".season ORDER BY "appearances".season ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "player_count" FROM "player" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ON (player_api_id) player_api_id, volleys FROM "player_attributes" ORDER BY player_api_id ASC, date DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC) AS "latest" ON "latest".player_api_id = "p".player_api_id WHERE "p".height > 180 AND "latest".volleys > 70 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("t".total_home_goals, 0)), 2) AS "average_total_home_goals" FROM "player" AS "p" LEFT JOIN (SELECT home_player_3, SUM(home_team_goal) AS "total_home_goals" FROM "match" GROUP BY home_player_3) AS "t" ON "t".home_player_3 = "p".player_api_id LIMIT 501

SELECT country_name FROM (SELECT "c".name AS "country_name", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT "p".player_api_id) ASC) AS "player_rank" FROM "country" AS "c" INNER JOIN "match" AS "m" ON "m".country_id = "c".id LEFT JOIN "player" AS "p" ON "p".weight <= 160 AND "p".player_api_id IN ("m".home_player_1, "m".home_player_2, "m".home_player_3, "m".home_player_4, "m".home_player_5, "m".home_player_6, "m".home_player_7, "m".home_player_8, "m".home_player_9, "m".home_player_10, "m".home_player_11, "m".away_player_1, "m".away_player_2, "m".away_player_3, "m".away_player_4, "m".away_player_5, "m".away_player_6, "m".away_player_7, "m".away_player_8, "m".away_player_9, "m".away_player_10, "m".away_player_11) GROUP BY "c".id, "c".name) AS "ranked" WHERE player_rank = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".player_api_id) AS "player_count" FROM "player" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ON (player_api_id) player_api_id, preferred_foot, attacking_work_rate FROM "player_attributes" WHERE date < '2015-01-02' ORDER BY player_api_id ASC, date DESC, id DESC) AS "a" ON "a".player_api_id = "p".player_api_id WHERE "a".preferred_foot = 'left' AND "a".attacking_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "current_attributes".attacking_work_rate = 'low') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS "percentage" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (player_api_id) player_api_id, preferred_foot, attacking_work_rate FROM "player_attributes" ORDER BY player_api_id ASC, date DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC) AS "current_attributes" WHERE "current_attributes".preferred_foot = 'left' AND "current_attributes".attacking_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium', 'high') LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".player_name, COUNT("m".id) AS "matches_played" FROM "player" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "match" AS "m" ON "m".season = '2015/2016' AND ("p".player_api_id IN ("m".home_player_1, "m".home_player_2, "m".home_player_3, "m".home_player_4, "m".home_player_5, "m".home_player_6, "m".home_player_7, "m".home_player_8, "m".home_player_9, "m".home_player_10, "m".home_player_11, "m".away_player_1, "m".away_player_2, "m".away_player_3, "m".away_player_4, "m".away_player_5, "m".away_player_6, "m".away_player_7, "m".away_player_8, "m".away_player_9, "m".away_player_10, "m".away_player_11)) WHERE "p".player_name LIKE 'Aaron%' AND "p".birthday >= '1991-01-01' GROUP BY "p".id, "p".player_name ORDER BY "p".player_name ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id) AS "player_count" FROM "player_attributes" WHERE jumping >= 80 AND date >= '2007-02-22' AND date < '2007-08-31' LIMIT 501

SELECT "ta".buildupplayspeedclass FROM "team" AS "t" INNER JOIN "team_attributes" AS "ta" ON "ta".team_api_id = "t".team_api_id WHERE "t".team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge' AND "ta".date <= (SELECT MAX("m".date) FROM "match" AS "m" WHERE "m".season = '2012/2013' AND ("m".home_team_api_id = "t".team_api_id OR "m".away_team_api_id = "t".team_api_id)) ORDER BY "ta".date DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (MAX(CASE WHEN "p".player_name = 'Landon Donovan' THEN "a".overall_rating END) - AVG("a".overall_rating)) / AVG("a".overall_rating), 2) AS "percentage" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (player_api_id) player_api_id, overall_rating, defensive_work_rate FROM "player_attributes" WHERE date < '2013-07-13' ORDER BY player_api_id ASC, date DESC, id DESC) AS "a" INNER JOIN "player" AS "p" ON "p".player_api_id = "a".player_api_id WHERE "a".defensive_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium', 'high') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".account_id, (SELECT MAX(a11) - MIN(a11) FROM "district") AS "salary_difference" FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "d" ON "d".client_id = "c".client_id WHERE "c".gender = 'F' AND "c".district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM "district" WHERE a11 = (SELECT MIN(a11) FROM "district")) AND "c".birth_date = (SELECT MIN("c2".birth_date) FROM "client" AS "c2" WHERE "c2".gender = 'F' AND "c2".district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM "district" WHERE a11 = (SELECT MIN(a11) FROM "district"))) LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "district".a2 AS "district" FROM "client" INNER JOIN "disp" ON "disp".client_id = "client".client_id INNER JOIN "account" ON "account".account_id = "disp".account_id INNER JOIN "district" ON "district".district_id = "account".district_id WHERE "client".gender = 'F' AND "client".birth_date = DATE '1976-01-29' AND "disp".type = 'OWNER' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "c".gender = 'M') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "male_percentage" FROM "client" AS "c" WHERE "c".district_id = (SELECT "d".district_id FROM "district" AS "d" WHERE "d".a3 = 'south Bohemia' ORDER BY CAST("d".a4 AS BIGINT) DESC LIMIT 1) LIMIT 501

SELECT ("b".balance::NUMERIC - "a".balance) * 100 / NULLIF("a".balance, 0) AS "percentage_increase" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "trans" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id AND "a".date = DATE '1993-03-22' INNER JOIN "trans" AS "b" ON "b".account_id = "l".account_id AND "b".date = DATE '1998-12-27' WHERE "l".date = DATE '1993-07-05' LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".account_id, "a".frequency FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "a".date >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND "a".date < DATE '2001-01-01' AND "d".a3 = 'east Bohemia' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "d".a2 AS "district", ROUND((("d".a13::NUMERIC - "d".a12::NUMERIC) / "d".a12::NUMERIC) * 100, 2) AS "unemployment_rate_percentage_change" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "l".status = 'D' AND "d".a12 IS NOT NULL AND "d".a13 IS NOT NULL AND "d".a12 <> 0 ORDER BY "d".a2 ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".type, COUNT(DISTINCT "d".account_id) AS "account_count" FROM "disp" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "d".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "r" ON "r".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "d".type <> 'OWNER' AND "r".a11 > 8000 AND "r".a11 <= 9000 GROUP BY "d".type LIMIT 501

SELECT 100.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN "l".date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1998-01-01' THEN "l".amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN "l".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1997-01-01' THEN "l".amount ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN "l".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1997-01-01' THEN "l".amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "percentage_growth" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "d".account_id FROM "disp" AS "d" INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "d".client_id WHERE "d".type = 'OWNER' AND "c".gender = 'M') AS "owners" ON "owners".account_id = "l".account_id WHERE "l".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1998-01-01' LIMIT 501
SELECT "a".frequency, "o".k_symbol FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "order" AS "o" ON "o".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "a".account_id = 3 AND "o".amount = 3539 LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 AS "district", "d".a4 AS "population" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE "a".date >= (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', MIN(date)) FROM "account") AND "a".date < (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', MIN(date)) + INTERVAL '1 month' FROM "account") AND "d".a4::BIGINT = (SELECT MAX("d2".a4::BIGINT) FROM "district" AS "d2" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a2" ON "a2".district_id = "d2".district_id WHERE "a2".date >= (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', MIN(date)) FROM "account") AND "a2".date < (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', MIN(date)) + INTERVAL '1 month' FROM "account")) GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a2, "d".a4 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "d".account_id FROM "disp" AS "d" INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "d".client_id WHERE "d".type = 'OWNER' AND "c".gender = 'M' AND "c".birth_date >= DATE '1974-01-01' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1977-01-01') AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "t".account_id WHERE "t".k_symbol IS NULL OR TRIM("t".k_symbol) = '' LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 AS "district_name", ROUND(COALESCE(SUM("l".amount), 0)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "a".account_id), 0)) AS "average_active_loan_per_account" FROM (SELECT district_id, a2 FROM "district" ORDER BY a4::BIGINT DESC LIMIT 5) AS "d" LEFT JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id LEFT JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id AND "l".status IN ('C', 'D') GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a2 ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM("l".amount), 0)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "a".account_id), 0) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 501

SELECT region, total_approved_amount FROM (SELECT "d".a3 AS "region", SUM("l".amount) AS "total_approved_amount", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM("l".amount) DESC) AS "ranking" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "l".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND "l".date + "l".duration * INTERVAL '1 month' > DATE '1995-12-31' GROUP BY "d".a3) AS "totals" WHERE ranking = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a".account_id) AS "account_count" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'north Bohemia' AND "a".date < DATE '1996-01-01' AND "t".bank = 'AB' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("d".a11)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_salary", COUNT(*) AS "number_of_districts" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "a".district_id FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "p" ON "p".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "p".client_id WHERE "c".birth_date >= DATE '1980-01-01' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1990-01-01') AS "served" ON "served".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'east Bohemia' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("eligible".a11), 2) AS "average_district_salary" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "d".district_id, "d".a11 FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".district_id = "d".district_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "owner_disp" ON "owner_disp".client_id = "c".client_id AND "owner_disp".type = 'OWNER' LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "account_disp".account_id FROM "disp" AS "account_disp" INNER JOIN "card" AS "card" ON "card".disp_id = "account_disp".disp_id) AS "card_accounts" ON "card_accounts".account_id = "owner_disp".account_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'central Bohemia' AND "card_accounts".account_id IS NULL) AS "eligible" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("account_loans".loan_count), 2) AS "average_loans_per_account" FROM (SELECT "a".account_id, COUNT("l".loan_id) AS "loan_count" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "d" ON "d".account_id = "a".account_id AND "d".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "d".client_id LEFT JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "c".birth_date < DATE '1950-01-01' GROUP BY "a".account_id) AS "account_loans" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "t".k_symbol = 'SIPO') AS "household_payments", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "t".k_symbol IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("t".k_symbol) <> '' AND "t".k_symbol <> 'SIPO') AS "other_purpose_payments" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "d".account_id FROM "disp" AS "d" INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "d".client_id WHERE "c".gender = 'M' AND "c".birth_date >= DATE '1974-01-01' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1977-01-01') AS "cohort" ON "cohort".account_id = "t".account_id WHERE "t".amount > 4000 AND "t".type IN ('VYDAJ', 'VYBER') LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".account_id AS "account_number", "a".date AS "account_opening_date", "l".total_borrowed, COALESCE("t".counterparties, 0) AS "outside_bank_counterparties", "home".a2 AS "owner_home_district", "home".a4::BIGINT AS "district_population", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "home".a4::BIGINT DESC NULLS LAST) AS "population_rank" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "branch" ON "branch".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN (SELECT account_id, SUM(amount) AS "total_borrowed" FROM "loan" GROUP BY account_id) AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "d" ON "d".account_id = "a".account_id AND "d".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "d".client_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "home" ON "home".district_id = "c".district_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT account) AS "counterparties" FROM "trans" WHERE operation IN ('PREVOD NA UCET', 'PREVOD Z UCTU') AND bank IS NOT NULL AND bank <> '' GROUP BY account_id) AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "branch".a2 = 'Prachatice' ORDER BY "home".a4::BIGINT DESC NULLS LAST, "a".account_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "g".gender, "g".district_count, "g".district_name, "g".inhabitants, "g".average_salary, "g".average_urban_ratio FROM (SELECT "d".gender, "d".district_name, "d".inhabitants, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY "d".gender) AS "district_count", ROUND(AVG("d".salary) OVER (PARTITION BY "d".gender), 2) AS "average_salary", ROUND(AVG("d".urban_ratio::NUMERIC) OVER (PARTITION BY "d".gender), 2) AS "average_urban_ratio", MAX("d".inhabitants) OVER (PARTITION BY "d".gender) AS "max_inhabitants" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "c".gender, "r".district_id, "r".a2 AS "district_name", "r".a4::BIGINT AS "inhabitants", "r".a11 AS "salary", "r".a10 AS "urban_ratio" FROM "card" AS "ca" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "cd" ON "cd".disp_id = "ca".disp_id INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "cd".account_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "o" ON "o".account_id = "a".account_id AND "o".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "o".client_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "r" ON "r".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN (SELECT account_id FROM "trans" GROUP BY account_id HAVING AVG(balance) > 1000) AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "ca".type = 'gold' AND "r".a4::BIGINT > 100000) AS "d") AS "g" WHERE "g".inhabitants = "g".max_inhabitants ORDER BY CASE WHEN "g".gender = 'F' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC, "g".district_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "q".recipient_bank_code, "q".recipient_counter_account_number, "q".outgoing_payment_count, "q".total_amount_paid FROM (SELECT "t".bank AS "recipient_bank_code", "t".account AS "recipient_counter_account_number", COUNT(*) AS "outgoing_payment_count", SUM("t".amount) AS "total_amount_paid", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM("t".amount) DESC) AS "payment_rank" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "t".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "dp".account_id FROM "disp" AS "dp" INNER JOIN "card" AS "c" ON "c".disp_id = "dp".disp_id WHERE "dp".type = 'OWNER' AND "c".type = 'gold') AS "gold_accounts" ON "gold_accounts".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "t".date >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "t".date < DATE '1999-01-01' AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL AND CAST("d".a4 AS BIGINT) >= 250000 GROUP BY "t".bank, "t".account) AS "q" WHERE "q".payment_rank = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN "t".k_symbol = 'SIPO' THEN "t".amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM("t".amount), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "t".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "d".a2 = 'Pisek' AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".k_symbol IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("t".k_symbol) <> '' LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a3 AS "region", ROUND(AVG("d".a11)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_district_salary", ROUND(AVG("d".a12)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_1996_district_unemployment_rate", (ARRAY_AGG("d".a2 ORDER BY "d".a4::BIGINT DESC, "d".a2 ASC))[1] AS "most_populous_district" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "c".district_id FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "p" ON "p".client_id = "c".client_id INNER JOIN "card" AS "ca" ON "ca".disp_id = "p".disp_id INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "p".account_id WHERE "c".gender = 'F' AND "p".type = 'OWNER') AS "qualifying" ON "qualifying".district_id = "d".district_id GROUP BY "d".a3 ORDER BY "d".a3 ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "t".a2 AS "district_name", "t".a15 AS "crimes_1996", ROUND(AVG("t".a15) OVER (), 2) AS "three_district_average", ROUND((SELECT AVG("d".a15) FROM "district" AS "d"), 2) AS "overall_average", ROUND(AVG("t".a15) OVER () - (SELECT AVG("d".a15) FROM "district" AS "d"), 2) AS "difference" FROM (SELECT "d".a2, "d".a4, "d".a15 FROM "district" AS "d" WHERE "d".a3 = 'central Bohemia' ORDER BY CAST("d".a4 AS BIGINT) DESC, TRANSLATE(LOWER("d".a2), 'áäčďéěíľĺňóôöŕřšťúůüýž', 'aacdeeillnooorrstuuuyz') ASC, "d".a2 ASC LIMIT 3) AS "t" ORDER BY CAST("t".a4 AS BIGINT) DESC, TRANSLATE(LOWER("t".a2), 'áäčďéěíľĺňóôöŕřšťúůüýž', 'aacdeeillnooorrstuuuyz') ASC, "t".a2 ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT type AS "card_type", district AS "home_district", inhabitants FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "ca".type, "d".a2 AS "district", CAST("d".a4 AS BIGINT) AS "inhabitants", DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "ca".type ORDER BY CAST("d".a4 AS BIGINT) ASC) AS "population_rank" FROM "card" AS "ca" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "di" ON "di".disp_id = "ca".disp_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "cl" ON "cl".client_id = "di".client_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "cl".district_id WHERE "ca".type IN ('gold', 'classic', 'junior') AND "d".a4 IS NOT NULL) AS "ranked" WHERE population_rank = 1 ORDER BY card_type ASC, home_district ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 AS "district_name", COUNT(*) AS "accounts_opened_1996", ROUND(AVG("t".balance), 2) AS "average_end_of_1996_balance", ROUND(SUM(SUM("t".balance)) OVER () / NULLIF(SUM(COUNT("t".balance)) OVER (), 0), 2) AS "region_wide_average_end_of_1996_balance", FIRST_VALUE("d".a2) OVER (ORDER BY AVG("t".balance) DESC NULLS LAST, "d".a2 ASC) AS "district_with_highest_average" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id LEFT JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".trans_id = (SELECT "t2".trans_id FROM "trans" AS "t2" WHERE "t2".account_id = "a".account_id AND "t2".date < DATE '1997-01-01' ORDER BY "t2".date DESC, "t2".trans_id DESC LIMIT 1) WHERE "d".a3 = (SELECT a3 FROM "district" WHERE a2 = 'Litomerice') AND "a".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND "a".date < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a2 ORDER BY "d".a2 ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 AS "district", "d".a4::BIGINT AS "inhabitants", (SELECT ROUND(AVG("d2".a11), 2) FROM "district" AS "d2" WHERE "d2".district_id IN (SELECT "top_loans".district_id FROM (SELECT "a".district_id FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id WHERE "l".duration = 24 AND "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' ORDER BY "l".amount DESC, "l".loan_id ASC LIMIT 10) AS "top_loans")) AS "average_salary" FROM "district" AS "d" WHERE "d".district_id IN (SELECT "top_loans".district_id FROM (SELECT "a".district_id FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id WHERE "l".duration = 24 AND "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' ORDER BY "l".amount DESC, "l".loan_id ASC LIMIT 10) AS "top_loans") ORDER BY "d".a4::BIGINT DESC, "d".district_id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a3 AS "region", "d".a4::BIGINT AS "population", "w".total_withdrawn, ROUND("w".total_withdrawn / "d".a4::NUMERIC, 2) AS "withdrawals_per_inhabitant", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "w".total_withdrawn / "d".a4::NUMERIC DESC) AS "district_rank", ROUND(COALESCE("s".total_order_debits, 0) / "s".account_count, 2) AS "average_standing_order_debit_per_account" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN (SELECT "a".district_id, SUM("t".amount) AS "total_withdrawn" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "t".type = 'VYDAJ' GROUP BY "a".district_id) AS "w" ON "w".district_id = "d".district_id INNER JOIN (SELECT "a".district_id, COUNT(*) AS "account_count", SUM(COALESCE("o".order_debits, 0)) AS "total_order_debits" FROM "account" AS "a" LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, SUM(amount::NUMERIC) AS "order_debits" FROM "order" GROUP BY account_id) AS "o" ON "o".account_id = "a".account_id GROUP BY "a".district_id) AS "s" ON "s".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE "d".a4::BIGINT >= 100000 ORDER BY district_rank ASC, "d".a2 ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".account_id, "a".date AS "opened_date", "a".frequency, "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a3 AS "region", CASE WHEN "d".district_id = "c".district_id THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "home_district", "d".a11 AS "average_salary", COALESCE("l".status, 'none') AS "loan_repayment_status", COALESCE("l".amount, 0) AS "loan_amount", COALESCE("t".transaction_count, 0) AS "transaction_count", COALESCE("t".total_income, 0) AS "total_income", COALESCE("t".total_expense, 0) AS "total_expense", COALESCE("t".total_income, 0) - COALESCE("t".total_expense, 0) AS "net_balance", COALESCE("rc".client_count, 0) AS "regional_client_count", "d".most_populous_district, "d".most_populous_inhabitants, "d".population_rank FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".client_id = "c".client_id INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "dp".account_id INNER JOIN (SELECT district_id, a2, a3, a11, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a3 ORDER BY a4::BIGINT DESC) AS "population_rank", FIRST_VALUE(a2) OVER (PARTITION BY a3 ORDER BY a4::BIGINT DESC, district_id ASC) AS "most_populous_district", FIRST_VALUE(a4::BIGINT) OVER (PARTITION BY a3 ORDER BY a4::BIGINT DESC, district_id ASC) AS "most_populous_inhabitants" FROM "district") AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id LEFT JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "transaction_count", SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "total_income", SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "total_expense" FROM "trans" GROUP BY account_id) AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT "district".a3 AS "region", COUNT(*) AS "client_count" FROM "client" INNER JOIN "district" ON "district".district_id = "client".district_id GROUP BY "district".a3) AS "rc" ON "rc".region = "d".a3 WHERE "c".client_id = 3541 ORDER BY COALESCE("t".transaction_count, 0) DESC, "a".account_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT year AS "year", SUM(account_count) AS "number of accounts", SUM(amount_lent) AS "total amount lent", ROUND(AVG(amount_lent::NUMERIC / account_count), 2) AS "average district amount lent per account" FROM (SELECT TO_CHAR("a".date, 'YYYY') AS "year", "a".district_id, COUNT(*) AS "account_count", SUM(COALESCE("l".amount_lent, 0)) AS "amount_lent" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, SUM(amount) AS "amount_lent" FROM "loan" GROUP BY account_id) AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'central Bohemia' AND "a".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY TO_CHAR("a".date, 'YYYY'), "a".district_id) AS "district_year" GROUP BY year ORDER BY year ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 AS "district", "l".amount AS "approved_amount", "l".date AS "approval_date", (SELECT "t".balance FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".account_id = "l".account_id AND "t".date <= "l".date ORDER BY "t".date DESC, "t".trans_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS "end_of_day_balance" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "l".duration = 24 AND "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' ORDER BY "l".amount DESC, "l".date ASC, "l".loan_id ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT "c".client_id, "c".gender, "c".birth_date, "ca".type AS "card_type", EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "ca".issued) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "c".birth_date) AS "age_at_card_issue", COALESCE("l".loan_count, 0) AS "number_of_loans", COALESCE("l".total_amount, 0) AS "total_amount_borrowed", CASE WHEN COALESCE("l".loan_count, 0) = 0 THEN 'Non-borrower' WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "ca".issued) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "c".birth_date) < 30 THEN 'Young borrower' ELSE 'Mature borrower' END AS "borrower_classification", "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a11 AS "district_average_salary", RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "c".gender ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "ca".issued) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "c".birth_date) DESC) AS "age_rank_within_gender" FROM "card" AS "ca" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".disp_id = "ca".disp_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "dp".client_id LEFT JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "c".district_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "loan_count", SUM(amount) AS "total_amount" FROM "loan" GROUP BY account_id) AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "dp".account_id WHERE "ca".issued >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND "ca".issued < DATE '1995-01-01' ORDER BY "c".client_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 AS "branch_name", COUNT("t".trans_id) AS "transaction_count" FROM "district" AS "d" LEFT JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id LEFT JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id AND "t".date <= DATE '1998-10-14' AND ("t".k_symbol IS NULL OR TRIM("t".k_symbol) = '') WHERE "d".a3 = 'north Moravia' GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a2 ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, branch_name ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "t".bank AS "bank_code", "t".account AS "account_number", COUNT(*) AS "outgoing_payment_count", SUM("t".amount) AS "total_amount_paid" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "l".account_id WHERE "l".amount = 98832 AND "l".date = DATE '1996-01-03' AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".date < DATE '1996-01-03' AND "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "t".bank, "t".account ORDER BY total_amount_paid DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a".account_id) FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "a".district_id = 1 AND "a".date < DATE '1996-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1996-01-01' AND "l".status IN ('C', 'D') LIMIT 501

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN "t".k_symbol = 'UROK' THEN "t".amount WHEN "t".k_symbol = 'SANKC. UROK' THEN -"t".amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "net_interest_czk" FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".account_id IN (SELECT "d".account_id FROM "disp" AS "d" WHERE "d".client_id = 2823) AND "t".date >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "t".date < DATE '1999-01-01' AND "t".k_symbol IN ('UROK', 'SANKC. UROK') LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".client_id, ROUND("l".amount::NUMERIC, 2) AS "loan_amount", "l".duration AS "duration_months", ROUND("l".payments::NUMERIC * "l".duration, 2) AS "total_payments", ROUND("l".payments::NUMERIC * "l".duration - "l".amount, 2) AS "interest_paid", "l".status AS "loan_status", "d".a2 AS "district", "d".a3 AS "region", COALESCE("t".transaction_count, 0) AS "transaction_count", ROUND(COALESCE("t".total_deposits, 0)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "total_deposits", CASE WHEN COALESCE("t".total_deposits, 0) > 2::NUMERIC * "l".amount THEN 'High Income' WHEN COALESCE("t".total_deposits, 0) > "l".amount THEN 'Medium Income' ELSE 'Low Income' END AS "income_category", "rl".loan_count AS "loans_in_region", ROUND("rs".average_salary, 2) AS "region_average_salary", EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "c".birth_date))::INTEGER AS "completed_age" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".account_id = "a".account_id AND "dp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "dp".client_id AND "c".gender = 'F' LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "transaction_count", SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "total_deposits" FROM "trans" GROUP BY account_id) AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN (SELECT "d2".a3 AS "region", COUNT(*) AS "loan_count" FROM "loan" AS "l2" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a2" ON "a2".account_id = "l2".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d2" ON "d2".district_id = "a2".district_id GROUP BY "d2".a3) AS "rl" ON "rl".region = "d".a3 INNER JOIN (SELECT a3 AS "region", AVG(a11::NUMERIC) AS "average_salary" FROM "district" GROUP BY a3) AS "rs" ON "rs".region = "d".a3 WHERE "l".amount >= (SELECT MIN("top_loans".amount) FROM (SELECT "l3".amount FROM "loan" AS "l3" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp3" ON "dp3".account_id = "l3".account_id AND "dp3".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c3" ON "c3".client_id = "dp3".client_id AND "c3".gender = 'F' ORDER BY "l3".amount DESC LIMIT 3) AS "top_loans") ORDER BY "l".amount DESC, "l".loan_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a3 AS "region", COUNT(DISTINCT "d".district_id) AS "district_count", SUM("d".a4::BIGINT) AS "combined_population", SUM("q".account_count) AS "account_count" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN (SELECT "a".district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".account_id) AS "account_count" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "a".date < DATE '1997-01-01' AND "l".duration > 24 GROUP BY "a".district_id) AS "q" ON "q".district_id = "d".district_id GROUP BY "d".a3 ORDER BY combined_population DESC, "d".a3 ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT COALESCE(SUM("a".account_count), 0) AS "total_monthly_statement_accounts", COUNT(*) AS "district_count", ROUND(AVG("d".a11), 2) AS "average_salary" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN (SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS "account_count" FROM "account" WHERE frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE' AND date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND date < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY district_id) AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE "d".a4::BIGINT >= 100000 LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".account_id, "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a3 AS "region", COALESCE("t".total_received, 0) AS "total_received", COALESCE("t".total_withdrawn, 0) AS "total_withdrawn", COALESCE("l".number_of_loans, 0) AS "number_of_loans", COALESCE("t".external_counterparties, 0) AS "external_counterparties", DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE("t".external_counterparties, 0) DESC) AS "rank" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "disp".account_id FROM "disp" INNER JOIN "card" ON "card".disp_id = "disp".disp_id WHERE "card".type = 'gold') AS "g" ON "g".account_id = "a".account_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE type = 'PRIJEM') AS "total_received", SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE type = 'VYDAJ') AS "total_withdrawn", COUNT(DISTINCT (bank, account)) FILTER (WHERE operation IN ('PREVOD NA UCET', 'PREVOD Z UCTU') AND bank IS NOT NULL AND bank <> '' AND account IS NOT NULL) AS "external_counterparties" FROM "trans" GROUP BY account_id) AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "number_of_loans" FROM "loan" GROUP BY account_id) AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id ORDER BY rank ASC, "a".account_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".account_id, "a".date AS "opened_date", "c".gender AS "owner_gender", EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '1996-12-31', "c".birth_date)) AS "owner_age", COALESCE("cards".card_count, 0) AS "card_count", COALESCE("loans".loan_count, 0) AS "loan_count", CASE WHEN COALESCE("loans".loan_count, 0) = 0 THEN 'no loan' WHEN "loans".has_default THEN 'defaulted' WHEN "loans".has_repaying THEN 'repaying' ELSE 'paid off' END AS "loan_standing", COALESCE("t".transaction_count, 0) AS "transaction_count", COALESCE("t".money_in, 0) AS "money_in", COALESCE("t".money_out, 0) AS "money_out", COALESCE("t".peak_balance, 0) AS "peak_balance", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE("t".peak_balance, 0) DESC) AS "peak_balance_rank" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "owner_disp" ON "owner_disp".account_id = "a".account_id AND "owner_disp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "owner_disp".client_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT "di".account_id, COUNT(*) AS "card_count" FROM "disp" AS "di" INNER JOIN "card" AS "ca" ON "ca".disp_id = "di".disp_id WHERE "ca".issued < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY "di".account_id) AS "cards" ON "cards".account_id = "a".account_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "loan_count", BOOL_OR(status = 'B') AS "has_default", BOOL_OR(status IN ('C', 'D')) AS "has_repaying" FROM "loan" WHERE date < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY account_id) AS "loans" ON "loans".account_id = "a".account_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "transaction_count", SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "money_in", SUM(CASE WHEN type IN ('VYDAJ', 'VYBER') THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "money_out", MAX(balance) AS "peak_balance" FROM "trans" WHERE date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND date < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY account_id) AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "d".a2 = 'Tabor' AND "a".date < DATE '1997-01-01' ORDER BY peak_balance_rank ASC, "a".account_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 AS "district_name", COUNT(DISTINCT "owners".client_id) AS "client_count", COUNT(DISTINCT ("t".bank, "t".account)) FILTER (WHERE "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".bank <> '' AND "t".account IS NOT NULL) AS "external_account_count", COALESCE(SUM("t".amount) FILTER (WHERE "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".bank <> '' AND "t".account IS NOT NULL), 0) AS "total_outgoing_payments" FROM "district" AS "d" LEFT JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "di".account_id, "di".client_id FROM "disp" AS "di" INNER JOIN "card" AS "c" ON "c".disp_id = "di".disp_id WHERE "di".type = 'OWNER' AND "c".type = 'classic') AS "owners" ON "owners".account_id = "a".account_id LEFT JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "owners".account_id AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' WHERE "a".account_id IS NULL OR "owners".account_id IS NOT NULL OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "account" AS "a2" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "di2" ON "di2".account_id = "a2".account_id INNER JOIN "card" AS "c2" ON "c2".disp_id = "di2".disp_id WHERE "a2".district_id = "d".district_id AND "di2".type = 'OWNER' AND "c2".type = 'classic') GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a2 ORDER BY total_outgoing_payments DESC, "d".a2 ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("district".a11), 2) AS "average_salary" FROM "client" INNER JOIN "disp" ON "disp".client_id = "client".client_id INNER JOIN "account" ON "account".account_id = "disp".account_id INNER JOIN "district" ON "district".district_id = "account".district_id WHERE "client".gender = 'F' AND "client".birth_date < DATE '1930-01-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("d".a11)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_salary" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT district_id FROM "client" WHERE gender = 'F' AND birth_date < DATE '1950-01-01') AS "c" ON "c".district_id = "d".district_id LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("d".a11)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_district_salary" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "a".district_id FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "l".amount < 100000 AND "l".status = 'C') AS "qualifying_districts" ON "qualifying_districts".district_id = "d".district_id LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "c".birth_date >= DATE '1980-01-01' THEN 'young' ELSE 'old' END AS "cohort", ROUND(AVG("d".a11)) AS "average_salary" FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "p" ON "p".client_id = "c".client_id INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "p".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "c".birth_date >= DATE '1980-01-01' OR "c".birth_date < DATE '1920-01-01' GROUP BY CASE WHEN "c".birth_date >= DATE '1980-01-01' THEN 'young' ELSE 'old' END ORDER BY CASE WHEN "c".birth_date >= DATE '1980-01-01' THEN 'young' ELSE 'old' END DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND((("r853".fastestlapspeed::NUMERIC - "r854".fastestlapspeed::NUMERIC) / "r854".fastestlapspeed::NUMERIC) * 100, 2) AS "percentage" FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "r853" ON "r853".driverid = "d".driverid AND "r853".raceid = 853 INNER JOIN "results" AS "r854" ON "r854".driverid = "d".driverid AND "r854".raceid = 854 WHERE "d".forename = 'Paul' AND "d".surname = 'di Resta' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN "res".position = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage_not_victories" FROM "results" AS "res" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "res".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "res".raceid WHERE "d".forename = 'Lewis' AND "d".surname = 'Hamilton' AND "r".year >= 2010 LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, "d".nationality, (SELECT MAX("ds".points) FROM "driverstandings" AS "ds" WHERE "ds".driverid = "d".driverid) AS "highest_driver_standings_points" FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".position = 1 GROUP BY "d".driverid, "d".forename, "d".surname, "d".nationality ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(("last_finisher".milliseconds - "winner".milliseconds)::NUMERIC * 100 / "last_finisher".milliseconds, 2) AS "percentage" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "winner" ON "winner".raceid = "r".raceid AND "winner".position = 1 INNER JOIN "results" AS "last_finisher" ON "last_finisher".raceid = "r".raceid AND "last_finisher".laps = "winner".laps AND "last_finisher".milliseconds IS NOT NULL WHERE "r".year = 1988 AND "r".name = 'Australian Grand Prix' ORDER BY "last_finisher".positionorder DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "res".laps = "winner".laps) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "results" AS "res" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "res".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "res".raceid INNER JOIN "results" AS "winner" ON "winner".raceid = "res".raceid AND "winner".position = 1 WHERE "d".nationality = 'Japanese' AND "r".year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009 LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".year, ROUND(AVG("res".milliseconds::NUMERIC) / 1000, 2) AS "mean_winner_elapsed_seconds" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "r".year < 1975 AND "res".position = 1 AND "res".milliseconds IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "r".year ORDER BY "r".year ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "d".dob < DATE '1985-01-01' AND "res".laps > 50) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "percentage" FROM "results" AS "res" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "res".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "res".driverid WHERE "r".year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005 LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM("res".points) AS "score", "c".name, "c".nationality FROM "results" AS "res" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "res".raceid INNER JOIN "constructors" AS "c" ON "c".constructorid = "res".constructorid WHERE "r".name = 'Monaco Grand Prix' AND "r".year BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010 GROUP BY "c".constructorid, "c".name, "c".nationality ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid WHERE "c".name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit' AND "r".year = 2008 AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q3 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' ORDER BY split_part("q".q3, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q".q3, ':', 2)::NUMERIC ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT "d".forename || ' ' || "d".surname AS "full_name" FROM "laptimes" AS "l" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "l".driverid WHERE "l".milliseconds IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "d".driverid, "d".forename, "d".surname ORDER BY MIN("l".milliseconds) ASC, "d".driverid ASC LIMIT 20

SELECT "c".name, (MIN("l".milliseconds) / 60000)::TEXT || ':' || TO_CHAR((MIN("l".milliseconds) / 1000) % 60, 'FM00') || '.' || TO_CHAR(MIN("l".milliseconds) % 1000, 'FM000') AS "fastest_lap_time" FROM "circuits" AS "c" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".circuitid = "c".circuitid INNER JOIN "laptimes" AS "l" ON "l".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "c".country = 'Italy' AND "l".milliseconds IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "c".circuitid, "c".name LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("race_pit_stops".stop_count), 2) AS "average_pit_stops_per_race" FROM (SELECT "r".raceid, COUNT("p".stop) AS "stop_count" FROM "races" AS "r" LEFT JOIN "pitstops" AS "p" ON "p".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "races" AS "r2000" WHERE "r2000".year = 2000 AND "r2000".name = "r".name) GROUP BY "r".raceid) AS "race_pit_stops" LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, "d".url, "d".dob, COUNT("q".q3) AS "q3_times" FROM "drivers" AS "d" LEFT JOIN "qualifying" AS "q" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q3 <> '' WHERE "d".nationality = 'German' AND "d".dob >= DATE '1971-01-01' AND "d".dob < DATE '1986-01-01' GROUP BY "d".driverid, "d".forename, "d".surname, "d".url, "d".dob ORDER BY q3_times DESC, "d".dob ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".driverref, "d".nationality, "d".dob, "q".q1 FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 1995 AND "r".name = 'Japanese Grand Prix' AND "q".q1 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q1 <> '' AND "q".q1 = (SELECT "q2".q1 FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "r".raceid AND "q2".q1 IS NOT NULL AND "q2".q1 <> '' ORDER BY split_part("q2".q1, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q2".q1, ':', 2)::NUMERIC DESC LIMIT 1) LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 1995 AND "r".name = 'Japanese Grand Prix' AND "q".q1 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q1 <> '' AND "q".q1 <> 'N/A' AND "q".q1 = (SELECT MAX("q2".q1) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "r".raceid AND "q2".q1 IS NOT NULL AND "q2".q1 <> '' AND "q2".q1 <> 'N/A') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, "q".q1 FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 1995 AND "r".name = 'Japanese Grand Prix' AND "q".q1 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' AND (split_part("q".q1, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q".q1, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) = (SELECT MIN(split_part("q2".q1, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q2".q1, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "r".raceid AND "q2".q1 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "other".driverid) AS "drivers_outqualified" FROM "qualifying" AS "lucas" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "lucas".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "lucas".raceid INNER JOIN "qualifying" AS "other" ON "other".raceid = "lucas".raceid AND "other".position > "lucas".position WHERE "d".forename = 'Lucas' AND "d".surname = 'di Grassi' AND "r".year = 2010 LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q2 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q2 <> '' AND "q".q2 <> 'N/A' AND "q".q2 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q2) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "r".raceid AND "q2".q2 IS NOT NULL AND "q2".q2 <> '' AND "q2".q2 <> 'N/A') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, COUNT(*) AS "runners_up" FROM "results" AS "r" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "r".driverid WHERE "ra".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "r".position = 2 GROUP BY "d".forename HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY runners_up DESC, "d".forename ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, TO_CHAR("r".date + CAST("r".time AS TIME) + "res".milliseconds * INTERVAL '1 millisecond' + INTERVAL '4 hours', 'HH24:MI:SS.MS') AS "local_finish_time", "d".url FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "res".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Azerbaijan Grand Prix' AND "res".position = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".driverref, "d".nationality, "d".dob FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q2 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q2 <> '' AND ("q".q3 IS NULL OR "q".q3 = '') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q2 = (SELECT DISTINCT "q2".q2 FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "r".raceid AND "q2".q2 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]+[.][0-9]+$' ORDER BY "q2".q2 ASC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "q".driverid) AS "driver_count" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND CASE WHEN "q".q2 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]{2}[.][0-9]+$' THEN split_part("q".q2, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q".q2, ':', 2)::NUMERIC < 100 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".name, "c".location, "c".country, "r".year, "p".duration FROM "pitstops" AS "p" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "p".raceid INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid WHERE "p".milliseconds = (SELECT MAX(milliseconds) FROM "pitstops") LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("q".q3_count, 0)), 2) AS "average_q3_lap_times" FROM "drivers" AS "d" LEFT JOIN (SELECT driverid, COUNT(*) AS "q3_count" FROM "qualifying" WHERE q3 IS NOT NULL AND q3 <> '' AND q3 <> 'N/A' GROUP BY driverid) AS "q" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".dob >= DATE '1981-01-01' AND "d".dob < DATE '1992-01-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid INNER JOIN (SELECT forename FROM "drivers" GROUP BY forename HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AS "shared" ON "shared".forename = "d".forename WHERE ("d".code IS NULL OR TRIM("d".code) = '') AND CASE WHEN "q".q1 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-5][0-9]([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN split_part("q".q1, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q".q1, ':', 2)::NUMERIC > 120 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".driverref, COALESCE(SUM("t".points), 0) AS "total_points" FROM "drivers" AS "d" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "r".driverid, "r".points FROM "results" AS "r" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT driverid, raceid FROM "laptimes") AS "l" ON "l".driverid = "r".driverid AND "l".raceid = "r".raceid) AS "t" ON "t".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".forename = 'Robert' GROUP BY "d".driverid, "d".driverref LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".date, "d".forename, "d".surname, ("fl".fastest_ms / 60000)::TEXT || ':' || TO_CHAR(("fl".fastest_ms % 60000) / 1000, 'FM00') || '.' || TO_CHAR("fl".fastest_ms % 1000, 'FM000') AS "fastest_lap_time" FROM "races" AS "r" LEFT JOIN (SELECT raceid, driverid, MIN(milliseconds) AS "fastest_ms" FROM "laptimes" WHERE milliseconds IS NOT NULL GROUP BY raceid, driverid HAVING MIN(milliseconds) > 90000) AS "fl" ON "fl".raceid = "r".raceid LEFT JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "fl".driverid WHERE "r".name = 'French Grand Prix' AND "r".year >= 1990 ORDER BY "r".date ASC, "d".surname ASC, "fl".fastest_ms ASC, "d".forename ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "d".forename, "d".surname, "q".q3 FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "d".nationality = 'Italian' AND "q".q3 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]{2}[.][0-9]+$' AND (split_part("q".q3, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q".q3, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) = (SELECT MIN(split_part("q2".q3, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q2".q3, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d2" ON "d2".driverid = "q2".driverid WHERE "d2".nationality = 'Italian' AND "q2".q3 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]{2}[.][0-9]+$') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename || ' ' || "d".surname AS "driver_full_name", "r".name AS "race_name", "r".year AS "race_year", "q".q3 AS "q3_time" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "d".nationality = 'British' AND "d".dob >= DATE '1981-01-01' AND "q".q3 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]{2}[.][0-9]+$' AND SPLIT_PART("q".q3, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + SPLIT_PART("q".q3, ':', 2)::NUMERIC = (SELECT MIN(SPLIT_PART("q2".q3, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + SPLIT_PART("q2".q3, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d2" ON "d2".driverid = "q2".driverid WHERE "d2".nationality = 'British' AND "d2".dob >= DATE '1981-01-01' AND "q2".q3 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]{2}[.][0-9]+$') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "x".driverid) AS "driver_count" FROM (SELECT "r".driverid, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "r".raceid ORDER BY "r".fastestlaptime ASC) AS "lap_rank" FROM "results" AS "r" WHERE "r".fastestlaptime IS NOT NULL AND "r".fastestlaptime <> '' AND "r".fastestlaptime <> '0') AS "x" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "x".driverid WHERE "x".lap_rank = 2 AND "d".dob >= DATE '1976-01-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".driverref FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' AND (split_part("q".q3, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q".q3, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) = (SELECT MIN(split_part("q2".q3, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q2".q3, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "r".raceid AND "q2".q3 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$') LIMIT 501

SELECT "ranked".name, "ranked".career_points, "ranked".url FROM (SELECT "totals".name, "totals".career_points, "totals".url, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "totals".career_points DESC) AS "points_rank" FROM (SELECT "c".constructorid, "c".name, "c".url, COALESCE(SUM("final_standings".points), 0) AS "career_points" FROM "constructors" AS "c" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "cs".constructorid, "cs".points, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "cs".constructorid, "r".year ORDER BY "r".round DESC, "r".raceid DESC, "cs".constructorstandingsid DESC) AS "season_row" FROM "constructorstandings" AS "cs" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "cs".raceid) AS "final_standings" ON "final_standings".constructorid = "c".constructorid AND "final_standings".season_row = 1 WHERE "c".nationality = 'Italian' GROUP BY "c".constructorid, "c".name, "c".url) AS "totals") AS "ranked" WHERE "ranked".points_rank <= 3 ORDER BY "ranked".points_rank ASC, "ranked".name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, COUNT(DISTINCT "d".driverid) AS "driver_count" FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".forename IN ('Peter', 'John') AND "r".position = 1 GROUP BY "d".forename ORDER BY CASE "d".forename WHEN 'Peter' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "q".q3 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]{2}[.][0-9]+$' AND (split_part("q".q3, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q".q3, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) = (SELECT MIN(split_part("q2".q3, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q2".q3, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".q3 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]{2}[.][0-9]+$') LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".nationality, COUNT(DISTINCT "r".constructorid) AS "constructor_count" FROM "constructors" AS "c" LEFT JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".constructorid = "c".constructorid AND "r".rank = 1 GROUP BY "c".nationality ORDER BY "c".nationality ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".year, COUNT("p".raceid) AS "total_pit_stops" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "ds".raceid FROM "driverstandings" AS "ds" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "ds".driverid WHERE "d".nationality = 'Australian' AND "ds".position BETWEEN 1 AND 19) AS "qualifying_races" ON "qualifying_races".raceid = "r".raceid LEFT JOIN "pitstops" AS "p" ON "p".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "r".year BETWEEN 2002 AND 2013 GROUP BY "r".year ORDER BY "r".year ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "q".driverid) AS "number_of_drivers" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "r".date >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND "r".date < DATE '1996-01-01' AND CASE WHEN "q".q1 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-5][0-9]([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN split_part("q".q1, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q".q1, ':', 2)::NUMERIC > 120 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename || ' ' || "d".surname AS "driver_full_name", "p".duration AS "pit_stop_time", "r".name AS "race_name", "c".name AS "circuit_name", "c".location AS "circuit_location" FROM "pitstops" AS "p" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "p".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "p".raceid INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid WHERE "r".date >= DATE '2016-09-01' AND "r".date < DATE '2016-10-01' AND "p".milliseconds = (SELECT MIN("p2".milliseconds) FROM "pitstops" AS "p2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "r2".raceid = "p2".raceid WHERE "r2".date >= DATE '2016-09-01' AND "r2".date < DATE '2016-10-01') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename || ' ' || "d".surname AS "full_name", "d".nationality, "first_win".name AS "first_win_race_name", "first_win".date AS "first_win_race_date", (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "career".raceid) FROM "results" AS "career" INNER JOIN "races" AS "cr" ON "cr".raceid = "career".raceid WHERE "career".driverid = "d".driverid AND "cr".year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017 AND "career".grid > 0) AS "races_started" FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "winning_result" ON "winning_result".driverid = "d".driverid AND "winning_result".position = 1 INNER JOIN "races" AS "first_win" ON "first_win".raceid = "winning_result".raceid AND "first_win".year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017 ORDER BY "d".dob ASC, "d".forename || ' ' || "d".surname ASC, "first_win".date ASC, "first_win".name ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "r".raceid) AS "runnings" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "status" AS "s" ON "s".statusid = "res".statusid WHERE "r".name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND "s".status = 'Accident' LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, "c".name AS "constructor_name" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid INNER JOIN "constructors" AS "c" ON "c".constructorid = "q".constructorid INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "q".raceid AND "res".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q2 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q2 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]{2}[.][0-9]{3}$' ORDER BY split_part("q".q2, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q".q2, ':', 2)::NUMERIC ASC, "res".grid ASC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1

SELECT "d".surname, "r".name FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "q".q2 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q2 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' AND split_part("q".q2, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q".q2, ':', 2)::NUMERIC = (SELECT MIN(split_part("q2".q2, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q2".q2, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "r2".raceid = "q2".raceid WHERE "r2".year = 2017 AND "q2".q2 IS NOT NULL AND "q2".q2 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".number FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]{2}[.][0-9]+$' AND (split_part("q".q3, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q".q3, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) = (SELECT MIN(split_part("q2".q3, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q2".q3, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "r".raceid AND "q2".q3 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]{2}[.][0-9]+$') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".code, "q".q3 AS "fastest_q3_time" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]{2}([.][0-9]+)?$' AND "q".q3::INTERVAL = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3::INTERVAL) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "r".raceid AND "q2".q3 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]{2}([.][0-9]+)?$') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q3 <> '' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "r".raceid AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q2".q3 <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".year, "res".time AS "runner_up_time_gap" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid AND "res".position = 2 WHERE "r".name = 'Chinese Grand Prix' AND "r".year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009 AND "r".time IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "r".time ASC, "r".year DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT "d".code FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q3 <> '' AND "q".q3 <> 'NaN' AND "q".q3 <> 'NULL' ORDER BY "d".code ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".year, "d".forename, "d".surname, "res".time FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "res".driverid WHERE "r".name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND "r".year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2017 AND "r".time <= '17:00:00' AND "res".position = 1 ORDER BY "r".year ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".number, "d".surname FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND CASE WHEN "q".q3 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]{2}[.][0-9]+$' THEN SPLIT_PART("q".q3, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + SPLIT_PART("q".q3, ':', 2)::NUMERIC < 98 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "earliest".circuitref AS "earliest_circuit_reference", "latest".circuitref AS "latest_circuit_reference", EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ("latest".start_time - "earliest".start_time)) AS "gap_seconds" FROM (SELECT "c".circuitref, "r".time::TIME AS "start_time" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid WHERE "r".time IS NOT NULL AND "r".time::TIME = (SELECT MIN("r2".time::TIME) FROM "races" AS "r2" WHERE "r2".time IS NOT NULL)) AS "earliest" CROSS JOIN (SELECT "c".circuitref, "r".time::TIME AS "start_time" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid WHERE "r".time IS NOT NULL AND "r".time::TIME = (SELECT MAX("r2".time::TIME) FROM "races" AS "r2" WHERE "r2".time IS NOT NULL)) AS "latest" ORDER BY "earliest".circuitref ASC, "latest".circuitref ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".dob >= DATE '1980-01-01' AND "d".dob < DATE '1990-01-01' AND "r".fastestlapspeed IS NOT NULL AND "r".fastestlapspeed ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' GROUP BY "d".driverid, "d".forename, "d".surname, "d".dob ORDER BY MAX(CAST("r".fastestlapspeed AS NUMERIC)) DESC, "d".dob ASC, "d".surname ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "d".driverref FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND ("q".q2 IS NULL OR "q".q2 = '') ORDER BY "q".q1 DESC NULLS LAST, "d".driverid ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "results".driverid) AS "withdrawn_drivers" FROM "results" INNER JOIN "races" ON "races".raceid = "results".raceid INNER JOIN "status" ON "status".statusid = "results".statusid WHERE "races".year = 1962 AND "races".name = 'British Grand Prix' AND "status".status = 'Withdrew' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "s".status = 'Finished' OR "s".status ~ '^[+][0-9]+ Laps?$') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "results" AS "res" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "res".raceid INNER JOIN "status" AS "s" ON "s".statusid = "res".statusid WHERE "r".year = 1957 AND "r".name = 'British Grand Prix' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(event_total)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "mean_total_expense_per_event" FROM (SELECT "b".link_to_event, SUM("e".cost) AS "event_total" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "m".member_id = "e".link_to_member INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".budget_id = "e".link_to_budget WHERE "m".first_name = 'Elijah' AND "m".last_name = 'Allen' AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM "e".expense_date::DATE) IN (9, 10) GROUP BY "b".link_to_event) AS "event_totals" LIMIT 501

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN "e".event_date::DATE >= DATE '2019-01-01' AND "e".event_date::DATE < DATE '2020-01-01' THEN "b".spent ELSE 0 END), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN "e".event_date::DATE >= DATE '2020-01-01' AND "e".event_date::DATE < DATE '2021-01-01' THEN "b".spent ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "difference" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date::DATE >= DATE '2019-01-01' AND "e".event_date::DATE < DATE '2021-01-01' LIMIT 501
SELECT notes FROM "income" WHERE source = 'Fundraising' AND date_received = '2019-09-14' LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN "e".event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN "b".amount END)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN "e".event_name = 'October Meeting' THEN "b".amount END), 0) AS "ratio" FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "e".event_id = "b".link_to_event WHERE "b".category = 'Advertisement' AND "e".event_name IN ('Yearly Kickoff', 'October Meeting') LIMIT 501

SELECT "t".event_name, "t".spending_to_budget_ratio FROM (SELECT "e".event_name, SUM("b".spent)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(SUM("b".amount), 0) AS "spending_to_budget_ratio", DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM("b".spent)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(SUM("b".amount), 0) DESC NULLS LAST) AS "ranking" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".status = 'Closed' GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name HAVING SUM("b".amount) <> 0 AND SUM("b".spent) IS NOT NULL) AS "t" WHERE "t".ranking = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".first_name, "m".last_name FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_member = "m".member_id GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".first_name, "m".last_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_event) > 7 LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".first_name, "m".last_name, "m".phone FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT link_to_member FROM "expense" WHERE cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM "expense")) AS "e" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id LIMIT 501

SELECT "soccer".head_count AS "womens_soccer_attendance", "fall".average_attendance, CASE WHEN "soccer".head_count > "fall".average_attendance THEN 'more' WHEN "soccer".head_count < "fall".average_attendance THEN 'fewer' ELSE 'equal' END AS "verdict" FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "head_count" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_name = 'Women''s Soccer') AS "soccer" CROSS JOIN (SELECT ROUND(AVG("event_counts".head_count), 1) AS "average_attendance" FROM (SELECT "e".event_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "head_count" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "e".event_date < '2019-12-01' GROUP BY "e".event_id) AS "event_counts") AS "fall" LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".department, COUNT(DISTINCT "m".major_id) AS "majors_offered", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "mb".member_id IS NOT NULL THEN "m".major_id END) AS "majors_held", ROUND(COUNT("mb".member_id)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "m".major_id), 0), 2) AS "average_members_per_major" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT department FROM "major" WHERE college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences') AS "d" INNER JOIN "major" AS "m" ON "m".department = "d".department LEFT JOIN "member" AS "mb" ON "mb".link_to_major = "m".major_id GROUP BY "d".department ORDER BY "d".department ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".type AS "event_type", COALESCE(SUM("a".member_count), 0) AS "members_attended", COALESCE(SUM("b".budgeted_amount), 0) AS "total_budgeted" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN (SELECT link_to_event, COUNT(link_to_member) AS "member_count" FROM "attendance" GROUP BY link_to_event) AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT link_to_event, SUM(amount) AS "budgeted_amount" FROM "budget" GROUP BY link_to_event) AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date::DATE >= DATE '2019-01-01' AND "e".event_date::DATE < DATE '2020-01-01' GROUP BY "e".type ORDER BY "e".type ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "ma".department, COALESCE(SUM("i".amount), 0) AS "total_dues" FROM "major" AS "ma" LEFT JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "m".link_to_major = "ma".major_id AND "m".position = 'Member' LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT link_to_member FROM "attendance") AS "a" ON "a".link_to_member = "m".member_id LEFT JOIN "income" AS "i" ON "i".link_to_member = "a".link_to_member AND "i".source = 'Dues' WHERE "ma".college IN (SELECT college FROM "major" WHERE department = 'Electrical and Computer Engineering Department') GROUP BY "ma".department LIMIT 501
