SELECT "m".first_name, "m".last_name, ROUND(SUM("b".amount::NUMERIC - "b".spent::NUMERIC), 2) AS "total_amount_left" FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT link_to_member, link_to_budget FROM "expense" WHERE cost > 50) AS "e" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".budget_id = "e".link_to_budget GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".first_name, "m".last_name ORDER BY total_amount_left DESC, "m".last_name ASC, "m".first_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COALESCE(SUM("i".amount), 0) AS "total_dues" FROM "income" AS "i" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "a".link_to_member FROM "attendance" AS "a" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "e".event_id = "a".link_to_event WHERE "e".event_name = 'Football game') AS "attendees" ON "attendees".link_to_member = "i".link_to_member WHERE "i".source = 'Dues' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "m".major_name) AS "major_count" FROM "major" AS "m" WHERE "m".college IN (SELECT "tm".college FROM "member" AS "t" INNER JOIN "major" AS "tm" ON "tm".major_id = "t".link_to_major WHERE "t".first_name = 'Tyler' AND "t".last_name = 'Hewitt') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "major" AS "m2" INNER JOIN "member" AS "cm" ON "cm".link_to_major = "m2".major_id WHERE "m2".college = "m".college AND "m2".major_name = "m".major_name) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("event_attendance".member_count), 2) AS "average_members" FROM (SELECT "e".event_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "member_count" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id AND "b".category = 'Advertisement' LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id GROUP BY "e".event_id) AS "event_attendance" LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name, "e".location, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "number_of_members_attended" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".type = 'Budget' AND "e".status = 'Closed' GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name, "e".location LIMIT 501

SELECT "ma".major_name, COUNT(DISTINCT "m".member_id) AS "attendee_count" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "m".member_id = "a".link_to_member INNER JOIN "major" AS "ma" ON "ma".major_id = "m".link_to_major WHERE "e".event_name = 'Football game' GROUP BY "ma".major_id, "ma".major_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "m".member_id) = (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "m2".member_id) FROM "event" AS "e2" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a2" ON "a2".link_to_event = "e2".event_id INNER JOIN "member" AS "m2" ON "m2".member_id = "a2".link_to_member INNER JOIN "major" AS "ma2" ON "ma2".major_id = "m2".link_to_major WHERE "e2".event_name = 'Football game' GROUP BY "ma2".major_id ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT "m2".member_id) DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY "ma".major_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "member" AS "m" WHERE "m".link_to_major = "ma".major_id)) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "major" AS "ma" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(event_count) FILTER (WHERE position IN ('President', 'Vice President', 'Secretary', 'Treasurer')), 2) AS "average_events_per_officer", ROUND(AVG(event_count) FILTER (WHERE position NOT IN ('President', 'Vice President', 'Secretary', 'Treasurer') OR position IS NULL), 2) AS "average_events_per_other_student" FROM (SELECT "m".member_id, "m".position, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_event) AS "event_count" FROM "member" AS "m" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_member = "m".member_id GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".position) AS "member_attendance" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT item) AS "count" FROM (SELECT LOWER(TRIM(SPLIT_PART("e".expense_description, ',', 1))) AS "item" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "e".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT link_to_event FROM "budget" WHERE amount - spent < 0) AS "ob" ON "ob".link_to_event = "b".link_to_event UNION ALL SELECT LOWER(TRIM(SPLIT_PART("e".expense_description, ',', 2))) AS "item" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "e".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT link_to_event FROM "budget" WHERE amount - spent < 0) AS "ob" ON "ob".link_to_event = "b".link_to_event UNION ALL SELECT LOWER(TRIM(SPLIT_PART("e".expense_description, ',', 3))) AS "item" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "e".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT link_to_event FROM "budget" WHERE amount - spent < 0) AS "ob" ON "ob".link_to_event = "b".link_to_event) AS "items" WHERE item <> '' LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name, ROUND(COALESCE("w".water_spent, 0)::NUMERIC / "a".attendees, 2) AS "water_spent_per_attendee" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN (SELECT link_to_event, COUNT(*) AS "attendees" FROM "attendance" GROUP BY link_to_event) AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT "b".link_to_event, SUM("x".cost::NUMERIC) AS "water_spent" FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "x".expense_description ILIKE '%water%' GROUP BY "b".link_to_event) AS "w" ON "w".link_to_event = "e".event_id LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "departments".department IS NOT NULL) AS "members_in_college", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "departments".department IS NULL) AS "members_not_in_college" FROM "member" AS "r" LEFT JOIN "major" AS "m" ON "r".link_to_major = "m".major_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT department FROM "major" WHERE college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences' AND department IS NOT NULL) AS "departments" ON "m".department = "departments".department LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "cb".link_to_event FROM "budget" AS "cb" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "cb".budget_id WHERE "x".expense_description ILIKE '%chips%' AND "x".cost > 0) AS "qualifying" ON "qualifying".link_to_event = "e".event_id GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name HAVING MAX("b".amount) = (SELECT MAX("b2".amount) FROM "budget" AS "b2" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "cb2".link_to_event FROM "budget" AS "cb2" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x2" ON "x2".link_to_budget = "cb2".budget_id WHERE "x2".expense_description ILIKE '%chips%' AND "x2".cost > 0) AS "qualifying2" ON "qualifying2".link_to_event = "b2".link_to_event) LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".expense_date, SUM("e".cost::NUMERIC) AS "total_cost" FROM "expense" AS "e" WHERE "e".expense_date = (SELECT MAX("ex".expense_date) FROM "expense" AS "ex" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "ex".link_to_member = "m".member_id WHERE "m".position = 'Vice President') GROUP BY "e".expense_date LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".type AS "event_category", COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "member_count" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".location = 'MU 215' GROUP BY "e".type ORDER BY "e".type ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "ma".college, COUNT(*) AS "number_of_majors" FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "major" AS "ma" ON "m".link_to_major = "ma".major_id GROUP BY "ma".college HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(college_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "college_count" FROM "member" AS "m2" INNER JOIN "major" AS "ma2" ON "m2".link_to_major = "ma2".major_id GROUP BY "ma2".college) AS "counts") ORDER BY "ma".college ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".location, COUNT(DISTINCT "x".expense_description) AS "number_of_different_things_bought" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT link_to_event FROM "budget" WHERE amount > 40) AS "qualifying_budget" ON "qualifying_budget".link_to_event = "e".event_id INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id GROUP BY "e".location LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM("b".amount) AS "total_amount_budgeted" FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "e".event_id = "b".link_to_event INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "pb".link_to_event FROM "budget" AS "pb" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "pb".budget_id WHERE "x".expense_description = 'Pizza') AS "pizza_events" ON "pizza_events".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "e".event_date < '2019-10-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(event_total)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_spent_per_event" FROM (SELECT "e".event_id, COALESCE(SUM("b".spent), 0) AS "event_total" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id GROUP BY "e".event_id) AS "event_spending" LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN (SELECT link_to_event, SUM(amount) AS "total_budget", SUM(spent) AS "total_spending" FROM "budget" GROUP BY link_to_event) AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT "b".link_to_event, SUM(CASE WHEN "x".expense_description IS NULL OR TRIM("x".expense_description) = '' THEN 0 ELSE LENGTH("x".expense_description) - LENGTH(REPLACE("x".expense_description, ',', '')) + 1 END) AS "purchases" FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id GROUP BY "b".link_to_event) AS "p" ON "p".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".status = 'Closed' AND COALESCE("b".total_spending, 0) <= COALESCE("b".total_budget, 0) ORDER BY COALESCE("p".purchases, 0) DESC, "e".event_id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT "e".type, COUNT("a".link_to_member) AS "number_of_members" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date::DATE >= DATE '2019-09-01' AND "e".event_date::DATE < DATE '2020-06-01' GROUP BY "e".type HAVING COUNT("a".link_to_member) = (SELECT MAX("t".member_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT("a2".link_to_member) AS "member_count" FROM "event" AS "e2" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a2" ON "a2".link_to_event = "e2".event_id WHERE "e2".event_date::DATE >= DATE '2019-09-01' AND "e2".event_date::DATE < DATE '2020-06-01' GROUP BY "e2".type) AS "t") LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".expense_description, COUNT(*) AS "record_count" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "e".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "b".category = 'Food' GROUP BY "e".expense_description ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, "e".expense_description ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT LOWER(TRIM(SPLIT_PART("e".expense_description, ',', "n".n))) AS "item_name", "b".category, SUM("e".cost::NUMERIC) AS "total_cost" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "e".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id INNER JOIN "event" AS "ev" ON "b".link_to_event = "ev".event_id CROSS JOIN (SELECT 1 AS "n" UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4) AS "n" WHERE "ev".event_name = 'October Meeting' AND "e".approved = 'true' AND TRIM(SPLIT_PART("e".expense_description, ',', "n".n)) <> '' GROUP BY LOWER(TRIM(SPLIT_PART("e".expense_description, ',', "n".n))), "b".category ORDER BY "b".category ASC, item_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name, "e".event_date, COALESCE("b".total_budgeted, 0) AS "total_amount_budgeted", COALESCE("a".member_count, 0) AS "number_of_members_attended" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN (SELECT link_to_event, SUM(amount) AS "total_budgeted" FROM "budget" GROUP BY link_to_event) AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT link_to_event, COUNT(DISTINCT link_to_member) AS "member_count" FROM "attendance" GROUP BY link_to_event) AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id ORDER BY "e".event_name ASC, "e".event_date::DATE ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "u".item_name, COUNT(*) AS "times_bought" FROM (SELECT TRIM(SPLIT_PART(CASE WHEN "e".expense_description = 'Bakery - Donuts, muffins' THEN 'Donuts, muffins' ELSE "e".expense_description END, ',', 1)) AS "item_name" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id WHERE "m".first_name ILIKE 'Sacha' AND "m".last_name ILIKE 'Harrison' UNION ALL SELECT TRIM(SPLIT_PART("e".expense_description, ',', 2)) AS "item_name" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id WHERE "m".first_name ILIKE 'Sacha' AND "m".last_name ILIKE 'Harrison' AND "e".expense_description LIKE '%,%' UNION ALL SELECT TRIM(SPLIT_PART("e".expense_description, ',', 3)) AS "item_name" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id WHERE "m".first_name ILIKE 'Sacha' AND "m".last_name ILIKE 'Harrison' AND "e".expense_description LIKE '%,%,%') AS "u" GROUP BY LOWER("u".item_name), "u".item_name ORDER BY "u".item_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".first_name || ' ' || "m".last_name AS "full_name", "s".kind_count, "s".total_spending FROM (SELECT "e".link_to_member, COUNT(DISTINCT TRIM(LOWER(SPLIT_PART(REPLACE("e".expense_description, 'Bakery - ', ''), ',', "n".n)))) FILTER (WHERE TRIM(SPLIT_PART(REPLACE("e".expense_description, 'Bakery - ', ''), ',', "n".n)) <> '') AS "kind_count", SUM("e".cost::NUMERIC) FILTER (WHERE "n".n = 1) AS "total_spending" FROM "expense" AS "e" CROSS JOIN (SELECT 1 AS "n" UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3) AS "n" WHERE "e".expense_date >= '2019-10-01' AND "e".expense_date < '2019-12-01' GROUP BY "e".link_to_member) AS "s" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "m".member_id = "s".link_to_member WHERE "s".kind_count = (SELECT MAX("t".kind_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT TRIM(LOWER(SPLIT_PART(REPLACE("e2".expense_description, 'Bakery - ', ''), ',', "n2".n)))) FILTER (WHERE TRIM(SPLIT_PART(REPLACE("e2".expense_description, 'Bakery - ', ''), ',', "n2".n)) <> '') AS "kind_count" FROM "expense" AS "e2" CROSS JOIN (SELECT 1 AS "n" UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3) AS "n2" WHERE "e2".expense_date >= '2019-10-01' AND "e2".expense_date < '2019-12-01' GROUP BY "e2".link_to_member) AS "t") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "maj".major_id) AS "number_of_majors" FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "major" AS "maj" ON "m".link_to_major = "maj".major_id WHERE "maj".department = 'Political Science Department' LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".colour, COUNT(*) AS "hero_count", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS "rank" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".eye_colour_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "c".colour <> 'No Colour' GROUP BY "c".colour ORDER BY hero_count DESC, "c".colour ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "s".superhero_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "sp".power_name = 'Super Strength' ORDER BY "s".superhero_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".alignment = 'Neutral') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "neutral_percentage", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".alignment = 'Neutral' AND "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') AS "marvel_neutral_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') > COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics') THEN 'Marvel Comics' WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics') > COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') THEN 'DC Comics' ELSE 'Tie' END AS "publisher", ABS(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics')) AS "difference" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "p".publisher_name IN ('Marvel Comics', 'DC Comics') LIMIT 501
SELECT "s".superhero_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".eye_colour_id WHERE "s".height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190 AND "c".colour = 'No Colour' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "s".height_cm BETWEEN 150 AND 180 LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".full_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Strength' AND "ha".attribute_value = (SELECT MAX("ha2".attribute_value) FROM "hero_attribute" AS "ha2" INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a2" ON "a2".id = "ha2".attribute_id WHERE "a2".attribute_name = 'Strength') AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("s".full_name) <> '' AND TRIM("s".full_name) <> '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".superhero_name, "p".publisher_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "e" ON "s".eye_colour_id = "e".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "h" ON "s".hair_colour_id = "h".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "sk" ON "s".skin_colour_id = "sk".id LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "e".colour = "h".colour AND "e".colour = "sk".colour AND "e".colour NOT IN ('-', 'N/A', 'Unknown', 'No Colour') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "c".colour = 'Blue') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "s".gender_id LEFT JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".skin_colour_id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics') > COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') THEN 'DC Comics' WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') > COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics') THEN 'Marvel Comics' ELSE 'Tie' END AS "publisher", ABS(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics')) AS "difference" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "p".publisher_name IN ('DC Comics', 'Marvel Comics') LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG("m".height_cm) AS "average_height_cm" FROM "superhero" AS "m" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "mp" ON "mp".id = "m".publisher_id WHERE "mp".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "m".height_cm > 0 AND "m".id IN (SELECT "mhp".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "mhp" WHERE "mhp".power_id NOT IN (SELECT "dhp".power_id FROM "hero_power" AS "dhp" INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "d" ON "d".id = "dhp".hero_id INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "dp" ON "dp".id = "d".publisher_id WHERE "dp".publisher_name = 'DC Comics' AND "dhp".power_id IS NOT NULL)) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "power_count" FROM (SELECT "hp".power_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "hs".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hs" INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "s" ON "s".id = "hs".power_id WHERE "s".power_name = 'Super Strength') AS "strength" ON "strength".hero_id = "hp".hero_id GROUP BY "hp".power_id HAVING COUNT(*) = COUNT("strength".hero_id)) AS "qualifying_powers" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg), 1) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".skin_colour_id WHERE "c".colour = 'Green' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg > 0 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id WHERE "a".alignment IS NULL OR "a".alignment NOT IN ('Good', 'Bad') LIMIT 501

SELECT power_name, hero_count FROM (SELECT "sp".power_name, COUNT(DISTINCT "s".id) AS "hero_count", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT "s".id) DESC) AS "power_rank" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("s".full_name) <> '' AND TRIM("s".full_name) <> '-' GROUP BY "sp".id, "sp".power_name) AS "ranked" WHERE power_rank = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg), 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Intelligence' AND "s".weight_kg > 0 AND "ha".attribute_value IN (SELECT "ha2".attribute_value FROM "superhero" AS "s2" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha2" ON "ha2".hero_id = "s2".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a2" ON "a2".id = "ha2".attribute_id WHERE "s2".superhero_name = 'Abomination' AND "a2".attribute_name = 'Intelligence') LIMIT 501

SELECT "g".gender, COUNT("q".id) AS "superhero_count" FROM "gender" AS "g" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "s".id, "s".gender_id FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".hair_colour_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "c".colour = 'Blue' GROUP BY "s".id, "s".gender_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) >= 10) AS "q" ON "q".gender_id = "g".id WHERE "g".gender IN ('Male', 'Female') GROUP BY "g".gender LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg))::BIGINT AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Strength' AND "s".weight_kg > 0 AND "ha".attribute_value IN (SELECT "hulk_ha".attribute_value FROM "superhero" AS "hulk" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "hulk_ha" ON "hulk_ha".hero_id = "hulk".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "hulk_a" ON "hulk_a".id = "hulk_ha".attribute_id WHERE "hulk".superhero_name = 'Hulk' AND "hulk_a".attribute_name = 'Strength') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) AS "distinct_superpowers" FROM (SELECT id, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY height_cm DESC) AS "height_rank" FROM "superhero" WHERE height_cm IS NOT NULL) AS "tallest" LEFT JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "tallest".id WHERE "tallest".height_rank <= 10 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "character_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" WHERE "s".race_id IS NULL AND "s".publisher_id IN (SELECT publisher_id FROM "superhero" WHERE superhero_name = 'A-Bomb') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("power_counts".power_count), 2) AS "average_superpowers_per_hero" FROM (SELECT "s".id, COUNT("hp".power_id) AS "power_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "r".id = "s".race_id INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "s".gender_id LEFT JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "r".race = 'God / Eternal' AND "g".gender = 'Male' GROUP BY "s".id) AS "power_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("portfolio".power_count), 1) AS "average_superpowers" FROM (SELECT "hp".hero_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) AS "power_count" FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "shared".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "shared" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "cryo_holder" ON "cryo_holder".power_id = "shared".power_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "cryo" ON "cryo".hero_id = "cryo_holder".hero_id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "cryo".power_id WHERE "sp".power_name = 'Cryokinesis') AS "eligible" ON "eligible".hero_id = "hp".hero_id GROUP BY "hp".hero_id) AS "portfolio" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("dc".weight_kg)) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "dc" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "dp" ON "dp".id = "dc".publisher_id WHERE "dp".publisher_name = 'DC Comics' AND "dc".weight_kg > 0 AND "dc".eye_colour_id IN (SELECT "marvel".eye_colour_id FROM "superhero" AS "marvel" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "mp" ON "mp".id = "marvel".publisher_id WHERE "mp".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".height_cm), 1) AS "average_height_cm" FROM "superhero" AS "s" WHERE "s".race_id IN (SELECT "a".race_id FROM "superhero" AS "a" WHERE "a".superhero_name = 'A-Bomb') AND "s".height_cm > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG("s".weight_kg) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "r".id = "s".race_id WHERE "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "superhero" AS "other" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "other".gender_id WHERE "other".race_id = "r".id AND "g".gender = 'Female') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "publisher_count" FROM "publisher" AS "p" INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "s" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "s".height_cm > 200 AND "p".publisher_name IS NOT NULL AND "p".publisher_name <> 'N/A' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "total_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Good' AND "p".publisher_name <> 'DC Comics' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg), 1) AS "average_weight_kg", COUNT("s".weight_kg) AS "superhero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "h".id) AS "hero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "h" INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "b" ON "b".publisher_id = "h".publisher_id AND "b".superhero_name = 'Blackwulf' INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "other" ON "other".eye_colour_id = "h".eye_colour_id AND "other".publisher_id <> "h".publisher_id LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".race, COUNT(*) AS "superhero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "r".id = "s".race_id WHERE "r".race <> '-' AND "s".publisher_id IN (SELECT publisher_id FROM "superhero" WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler') GROUP BY "r".id, "r".race HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(race_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "race_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s2" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r2" ON "r2".id = "s2".race_id WHERE "r2".race <> '-' AND "s2".publisher_id IN (SELECT publisher_id FROM "superhero" WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler') GROUP BY "r2".id) AS "counts") LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg), 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("ha".attribute_value), 1) AS "average_intelligence" FROM "hero_attribute" AS "ha" INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "hp".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "sp".power_name IN ('Super Speed', 'Death Touch')) AS "powered" ON "powered".hero_id = "ha".hero_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Intelligence' AND "ha".attribute_value IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN "g".gender = 'Male' THEN (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" WHERE "hp".hero_id = "s".id) END), 2) AS "male_average", ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN "g".gender = 'Female' THEN (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" WHERE "hp".hero_id = "s".id) END), 2) AS "female_average" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "s".gender_id WHERE "g".gender IN ('Male', 'Female') AND TRIM("s".full_name) ~ '^[[:alpha:]][[:alpha:]''.-]*([[:space:]]+[[:alpha:]][[:alpha:]''.-]*)+$' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(NULLIF("s".height_cm, 0)) FILTER (WHERE "s".height_cm > 0), 2) AS "average_height_cm", ROUND(AVG(NULLIF("s".weight_kg, 0)) FILTER (WHERE "s".weight_kg > 0), 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".skin_colour_id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Bad' AND "c".colour = 'Green' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".height_cm) FILTER (WHERE "s".height_cm > 0), 1) AS "average_height_cm", ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg) FILTER (WHERE "s".weight_kg > 0), 1) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'George Lucas' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".height_cm), 1) AS "average_height_cm" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "hp".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "target_hp" ON "target_hp".power_id = "hp".power_id INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "target" ON "target".id = "target_hp".hero_id WHERE "target".superhero_name = '3-D Man') AS "shared" ON "shared".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "s".height_cm > 0 AND "s".superhero_name <> '3-D Man' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".skin_colour_id INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "p" ON "p".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "c".colour = 'Green' AND "a".alignment = 'Bad' AND "s".weight_kg > 0 AND "p".power_name = 'Flight' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg), 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT hero_id FROM "hero_power") AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'George Lucas' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg), 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "s".gender_id INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' AND "a".alignment = 'Good' AND "s".weight_kg > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) AS "superpower_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "s".gender_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Male' AND "s".weight_kg < 70 LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".colour FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "r".id = "s".race_id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".hair_colour_id WHERE "r".race = 'Human' AND "s".height_cm > 0 ORDER BY "s".height_cm ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT MAX(power_count) AS "largest_number_of_superpowers" FROM (SELECT "s".id, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".power_name) AS "power_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id LEFT JOIN "superpower" AS "p" ON "p".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "s".weight_kg = (SELECT MIN(weight_kg) FROM "superhero" WHERE weight_kg > 0) GROUP BY "s".id) AS "hero_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "hero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Neutral' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("s".full_name) <> '' AND TRIM("s".full_name) <> '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".superhero_name, "s".full_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Speed' AND "ha".attribute_value = (SELECT MAX("ha2".attribute_value) FROM "hero_attribute" AS "ha2" INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a2" ON "a2".id = "ha2".attribute_id WHERE "a2".attribute_name = 'Speed') AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("s".full_name) <> '' AND TRIM("s".full_name) <> '-' AND LOWER(TRIM("s".full_name)) <> LOWER(TRIM("s".superhero_name)) AND LOWER(TRIM("s".full_name)) NOT IN ('krypto the superdog', 'mr. mxyzptlk') ORDER BY "s".superhero_name ASC, "s".full_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "eye".colour AS "eye_colour", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "hair".colour <> 'Brown') AS "hero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "eye" ON "eye".id = "s".eye_colour_id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "hair" ON "hair".id = "s".hair_colour_id GROUP BY "eye".id, "eye".colour HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "hair".colour = 'Brown') > 0 ORDER BY hero_count DESC, "eye".colour ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".alignment = 'Good') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id LEFT JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("s".full_name) <> '' AND TRIM("s".full_name) NOT IN ('-', 'N/A', 'Unknown') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".alignment = 'Good') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id LEFT JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT hero_id FROM "hero_power") AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("h".weight_kg), 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "h" WHERE "h".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "h".superhero_name <> '3-D Man' AND "h".id IN (SELECT "hp".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "target_power" ON "target_power".power_id = "hp".power_id INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "target" ON "target".id = "target_power".hero_id WHERE "target".superhero_name = '3-D Man') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "c".colour = 'No Colour') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "c".colour = 'Blue') AS "difference" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".eye_colour_id WHERE "s".weight_kg IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'M' AND "l".ua > 8.0 THEN "p".id END)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".ua > 6.5 THEN "p".id END), 0) AS "male_to_female_ratio" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE ("p".sex = 'M' AND "l".ua > 8.0) OR ("p".sex = 'F' AND "l".ua > 6.5) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("l".alb)::NUMERIC, 4) AS "average_alb" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".plt > 400 AND "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".tg >= 200 AND "p".birthday < DATE '1976-10-09' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".sex, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)) AS "age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".glu >= 180 AND "l"."T-CHO" < 250 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)) AS "age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".hct >= 52 GROUP BY "p".id, "p".birthday HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage_female" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE pt >= 14) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday < DATE '1971-10-09' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".description IS NULL AND "l".crp LIKE '%+%' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".sc170 IN ('negative', '0') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id AND "e".symptoms IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p"."admission" = '+') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "id" FROM "laboratory") AS "l" ON "l"."id" = "p"."id" WHERE "p"."birthday" >= DATE '1930-01-01' AND "p"."birthday" < DATE '1941-01-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT "l"."T-BIL", "l".date, "p".id, "p".sex, "p".birthday FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l".rnp::NUMERIC END = (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN rnp::NUMERIC END) FROM "laboratory") AND "l"."T-BIL" = (SELECT MAX("l2"."T-BIL") FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" WHERE CASE WHEN "l2".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l2".rnp::NUMERIC END = (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN rnp::NUMERIC END) FROM "laboratory")) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".birthday > DATE '1960-01-01' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l".rnp::NUMERIC > 10 ELSE FALSE END) LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "l".id, CAST("l".rnp AS BIGINT) AS "anti_rnp_titer" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "s" ON "s".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "s".ssa NOT IN ('negative', '0') AND "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND CAST("l".rnp AS BIGINT) = (SELECT MAX(CAST("r".rnp AS BIGINT)) FROM "laboratory" AS "r" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "q" ON "q".id = "r".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "s2" ON "s2".id = "q".id WHERE "q".admission = '-' AND "s2".ssa NOT IN ('negative', '0') AND "r".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM (SELECT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis = 'MCTD' GROUP BY "p".id HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN "l".plt BETWEEN 100 AND 400 THEN 1 END) > 0 AND COUNT(CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CASE WHEN CAST("l".rnp AS NUMERIC) > 5 THEN 1 END END) > 0) AS "qualifying_patients" LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("l".test_dates, 0))::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_laboratory_test_dates" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN (SELECT id, COUNT(DISTINCT date) AS "test_dates" FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id) GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "l".id, "l".date, "l".dna FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".admission = '+' AND "l".dna ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' AND "l".dna::NUMERIC = (SELECT MAX("l2".dna::NUMERIC) FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p2" ON "p2".id = "l2".id WHERE "p2".sex = 'F' AND "p2".admission = '+' AND "l2".dna ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$') ORDER BY "l".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".admission, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') AND CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST("l".rnp AS NUMERIC) > 16 ELSE FALSE END GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY "p".admission ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "h" ON "h".id = "p".id AND ("h".hct <= 29 OR "h".hct >= 52) INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "r" ON "r".id = "p".id AND CASE WHEN "r".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "r".rnp::NUMERIC > 16 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501
SELECT MAX(CAST(rnp AS BIGINT)) AS "highest_anti_rnp" FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "l".id IS NOT NULL) AS "had normal platelet result", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "l".id IS NULL) AS "never had normal platelet result" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE plt > 100 AND plt < 400) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ~* '^[[:space:]]*([^,;]+[[:space:]]+susp[[:space:]]*[,;][[:space:]]*)*(RA[[:space:]]*[,;][[:space:]]*SJS|SJS[[:space:]]*[,;][[:space:]]*RA)([[:space:]]*[,;][[:space:]]*[^,;]+[[:space:]]+susp)*[[:space:]]*$' OR "p".diagnosis ~* '^[[:space:]]*(RA[[:space:]]*[,;][[:space:]]*([^,;]+[[:space:]]+susp[[:space:]]*[,;][[:space:]]*)+SJS|SJS[[:space:]]*[,;][[:space:]]*([^,;]+[[:space:]]+susp[[:space:]]*[,;][[:space:]]*)+RA)[[:space:]]*$' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("l".tp::NUMERIC - 8.5), 3) AS "average_deviation" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "examination" WHERE diagnosis ~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]])SLE([^[:alnum:]]|$)' AND diagnosis !~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]])SLE[[:space:]]+susp([^[:alnum:]]|$)') AS "e" ON "e".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".tp > 8.5 LIMIT 501
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE birthday >= DATE '1960-01-01') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis ILIKE 'Psoriatic arthritis' LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".alb < 3.5 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE elevated) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM (SELECT "p".id, BOOL_OR(CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l".rnp::NUMERIC > 64 ELSE FALSE END) AS "elevated" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND ("l".rnp = 'negative' OR "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$') GROUP BY "p".id) AS "tested" LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG(1999 - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday)) AS "average_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE "U-PRO" IN ('3', '4', '300', '>=300', '>=1000')) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN "p".id END) AS "women", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'M' THEN "p".id END) AS "men" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".rnp IN ('64', '256') LIMIT 501

SELECT MIN(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "l".date) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday)) AS "youngest_age" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".rnp IN ('64', '256') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT("l".id) AS "total_laboratory_tests", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "l".id IS NULL) AS "patients_with_no_laboratory_tests" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ILIKE 'psoriatic arthritis' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS "patient_count" FROM "examination" WHERE "Examination Date" >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND "Examination Date" < DATE '1998-01-01' AND thrombosis > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT "e"."symptoms" FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p"."id" = "e"."id" WHERE "e"."thrombosis" = 1 AND "e"."symptoms" IS NOT NULL AND "p"."diagnosis" ILIKE '%SLE%' GROUP BY "e"."symptoms" ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, "e"."symptoms" ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT id) FILTER (WHERE diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%') / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT id), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "examination" WHERE thrombosis = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(first_examination - "First Date")) AS "average_delay_days" FROM (SELECT "p".id, "p"."First Date", MIN("e"."Examination Date") AS "first_examination" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission LIKE '%+%' GROUP BY "p".id, "p"."First Date") AS "patient_delays" LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND "l".date >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1995-01-01' AND "l".got < 60 GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)) AS "age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".ldh > 600 AND "l".ldh < 800 AND "l"."U-PRO" IN ('300', '>=300', '>=1000') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN "p".id END) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'M' THEN "p".id END) AS "difference" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis = 'RA' AND "l".un < 30 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patients_with_high_creatinine", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "total_patients", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) / COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id AND "l".cre >= 1.5 WHERE "p".sex IN ('M', 'F') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "l"."T-CHO", "p".admission, "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') AND "l"."T-CHO" IS NOT NULL AND "l"."T-CHO" = (SELECT MAX("l2"."T-CHO") FROM "patient" AS "p2" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l2" ON "l2".id = "p2".id WHERE "p2".admission = "p".admission) ORDER BY "p".admission ASC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "l".id, "l".rnp AS "anti-RNP level" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p"."First Date" >= DATE '1991-01-01' AND "p"."First Date" < DATE '1992-01-01' AND "l".rnp IN ('0', '1', '4', '15', '16', '64', '256') AND CASE WHEN "l".rnp IN ('0', '1', '4', '15', '16', '64', '256') THEN CAST("l".rnp AS INTEGER) END = (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN "l2".rnp IN ('0', '1', '4', '15', '16', '64', '256') THEN CAST("l2".rnp AS INTEGER) END) FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p2" ON "p2".id = "l2".id WHERE "p2"."First Date" >= DATE '1991-01-01' AND "p2"."First Date" < DATE '1992-01-01') LIMIT 501
SELECT AVG(hct) AS "average_hematocrit" FROM "laboratory" WHERE date >= DATE '1991-01-01' AND date < DATE '1992-01-01' AND "U-PRO" IN ('300', '>=300', '>=1000') AND hct IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p"."id") FILTER (WHERE "p"."admission" IN ('+', '+(')) AS "admitted", COUNT(DISTINCT "p"."id") FILTER (WHERE "p"."admission" = '-') AS "outpatient" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l"."id" = "p"."id" WHERE "p"."diagnosis" = 'SLE' AND "l"."U-PRO" IN ('30', '100', '300', '+1(30)', '+2(100)', '>=300', '>=1000') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id AND "l".rf IN ('-', '+-') LEFT JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id AND ("e".kct = '+' OR "e".rvvt = '+' OR "e".lac = '+') WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "e".id IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT id, MAX(date) AS "latest_sample" FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id) AS "s" ON "s".id = "p".id INNER JOIN (SELECT id, MAX(date) AS "latest_result" FROM "laboratory" WHERE sc170 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY id) AS "r" ON "r".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "r".id AND "l".date = "r".latest_result WHERE "s".latest_sample > DATE '1997-01-01' AND "l".sc170 IN ('negative', '0') GROUP BY "p".id LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "s" ON "s".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "u" ON "u".id = "p".id WHERE "s".ssa NOT IN ('negative', '0') AND "u"."U-PRO" NOT IN ('-', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "female_patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND CASE WHEN "l".dna ~ '^[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)$' THEN "l".dna::NUMERIC < 8 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".admission <> '-' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".alp >= 300) LIMIT 501
SELECT MAX(CAST(rnp AS NUMERIC)) AS "highest_anti_rnp" FROM "laboratory" WHERE cre < 1.5 AND rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE "p".sex WHEN 'F' THEN 'female' WHEN 'M' THEN 'male' END AS "sex", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND "l".hgb < 7.0 GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT id, date, rnp FROM "laboratory" WHERE got >= 60 AND rnp = (SELECT rnp FROM "laboratory" WHERE got >= 60 AND rnp IN ('0', '1', '4', '15', '16', '64', '256') ORDER BY LENGTH(rnp) DESC, rnp DESC LIMIT 1) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "eligibility_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday > DATE '1980-01-01' AND ("l".fg < 150 OR "l".fg > 450 OR "l"."U-PRO" IN ('3', '4', '300', '>=300', '>=1000')) LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE "p".admission WHEN '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital' WHEN '-' THEN 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "patient_group", COUNT("l".ldh) AS "normal_ldh_measurements" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') AND "l".ldh < 500 GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY CASE "p".admission WHEN '+' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patients_with_laboratory_results", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l"."T-BIL" >= 2.0 THEN "p".id END) AS "patients_with_elevated_total_bilirubin" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IS NULL OR "p".sex = '' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".admission LIKE '+%' AND "p".birthday >= DATE '1945-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1990-01-01' AND "e"."ANA Pattern" = 'P' LIMIT 501

SELECT "t".id, "t".sex, "t".highest_anti_rnp FROM (SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, MAX(CASE WHEN "l".rnp = 'negative' THEN 0 ELSE CAST("l".rnp AS INTEGER) END) AS "highest_anti_rnp", MIN("l".hgb) AS "min_hgb" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' GROUP BY "p".id, "p".sex) AS "t" WHERE "t".min_hgb < 10 AND "t".highest_anti_rnp = (SELECT MAX("s".highest_anti_rnp) FROM (SELECT "p2".id, MAX(CASE WHEN "l2".rnp = 'negative' THEN 0 ELSE CAST("l2".rnp AS INTEGER) END) AS "highest_anti_rnp", MIN("l2".hgb) AS "min_hgb" FROM "patient" AS "p2" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l2" ON "l2".id = "p2".id WHERE "p2".admission = '-' GROUP BY "p2".id) AS "s" WHERE "s".min_hgb < 10) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".date = (SELECT MIN("l2".date) FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" WHERE "l2".id = "l".id) AND "l".got < 60 AND CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST("l".rnp AS NUMERIC) > 10 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, "l".date, "l"."U-PRO" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND "l".date = (SELECT MAX("l2".date) FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" WHERE "l2".id = "l".id AND "l2"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".cpk < 250 AND CASE WHEN "l".rnp IN ('0', '1', '4', '15', '16', '64', '256') THEN CAST("l".rnp AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END > 4 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "e".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "e".id WHERE "e".thrombosis = 0 AND "l".rnp IN ('1', '4', '15', '16', '64', '256') LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".birthday FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp IN ('16', '64', '256')) AS "r" ON "r".id = "p".id WHERE "l".gpt < 60 GROUP BY "p".id, "p".birthday ORDER BY MAX("l".gpt) DESC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".pt < 14 AND CASE WHEN "l".rnp IN ('0', '1', '4', '15', '16', '64', '256') THEN CAST("l".rnp AS INTEGER) >= 16 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE("l"."date", "p"."birthday")) AS "age", "p"."diagnosis" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p"."id" = "l"."id" WHERE "p"."admission" = '+' AND "l"."dna" ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' ORDER BY CAST("l"."dna" AS NUMERIC) DESC, "l"."date" ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".sex FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ~* '(^|[,;[:space:]])SLE([[:space:]]*[(][^)]*[)])?([[:space:]]*[,;]|[[:space:]]*$)' AND "l"."T-BIL" >= 1.2 ORDER BY "p".sex ASC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital' ELSE 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "care setting", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l".rnp IN ('4', '15', '16', '64', '256') THEN "p".id END) AS "at least one anti-RNP result of at least 4", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l".rnp IN ('4', '15', '16', '64', '256') THEN "p".id END) AS "no such result" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".birthday <= DATE '1976-10-09' AND "p".admission IN ('+', '-') GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY "care setting" ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND (SELECT "l".igg FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".igg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "l".date DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) >= 2000 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "p".diagnosis, "l".dna AS "highest anti-DNA test result" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "l".dna ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' AND "l".dna::NUMERIC = (SELECT MAX("l2".dna::NUMERIC) FROM "patient" AS "p2" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l2" ON "l2".id = "p2".id WHERE "p2".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "l2".dna ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$') GROUP BY "p".id, "p".diagnosis, "l".dna LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital' ELSE 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "care_setting", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE (SELECT "l".igg FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".igg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "l".date DESC NULLS LAST, "l".igg DESC LIMIT 1) > 900 AND (SELECT "l".igg FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".igg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "l".date DESC NULLS LAST, "l".igg DESC LIMIT 1) < 2000) / COUNT(*), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY "p".admission ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN "p".id END) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'M' THEN "p".id END) AS "female_minus_male" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".date = (SELECT MAX("l2".date) FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" WHERE "l2".id = "p".id) AND CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l".rnp::NUMERIC >= 32 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".rnp IN ('256') AND "l".cpk < 250 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "later" WHERE "later".id = "l".id AND "later".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "later".date > "l".date) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "admission" = '+') AS "inpatients", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "admission" = '-') AS "outpatients", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "admission" = '+') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "admission" IN ('+', '-')), 0), 2) AS "inpatient_percentage" FROM "patient" WHERE "diagnosis" ~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]_])SLE([^[:alnum:]_]|$)' AND "diagnosis" !~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]_])SLE[[:space:]]+susp([^[:alnum:]_]|$)' LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, "p".birthday FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "p".id = "l".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "u" ON "p".id = "u".id WHERE "l".ldh >= 500 AND "u"."U-PRO" IN ('100', '300', '+2(100)', '>=300', '>=1000') GROUP BY "p".id, "p".sex, "p".birthday ORDER BY "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id) GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" WHERE sex = 'F' AND "First Date" >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "First Date" < DATE '1999-01-01' AND admission LIKE '+%' LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".symptoms, "p".diagnosis FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "e".diagnosis ~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]])SLE([^[:alnum:]]|$)' AND "e".diagnosis !~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]])SLE[[:space:]]+susp' AND "e".symptoms IS NOT NULL AND "e".symptoms <> '' AND "p".birthday IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "p".birthday DESC, "p".id ASC, "e"."Examination Date" DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

SELECT diagnosis FROM "patient" WHERE "First Date" >= DATE '1998-02-15' AND "First Date" < DATE '1998-03-01' AND admission IN ('+', '+(') AND birthday IS NOT NULL ORDER BY age("First Date", birthday) DESC, id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(AVG("aCL IgM")::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average anti-cardiolipin IgM" FROM "examination" WHERE "Examination Date" >= DATE '1993-10-01' AND "Examination Date" < DATE '1993-11-01' AND diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SLE susp%' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis ILIKE 'psoriatic arthritis' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'M') AS "male_patients", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') AS "female_patients" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex IN ('M', 'F') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".gpt >= 60) LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".admission, COUNT(*) AS "patient_count", ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday))), 1) AS "average_completed_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rbc < 3.5) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY "p".admission ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "number_of_patients" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("e"."aCL IgM")::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average anti-cardiolipin IgM" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SJS%' AND "p".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SJS susp%' AND "e"."aCL IgM" <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "e".diagnosis ~* '(^|,)[[:space:]]*SjS[[:space:]]*(,|$)' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".rnp IN ('negative', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "s" ON "s".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "u" ON "u".id = "p".id WHERE "s".sm IN ('negative', '0') AND "e".thrombosis = 0 AND "u"."U-PRO" IN ('30', '100', '300', '+1(30)', '+2(100)', '>=1000', '>=300') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "x" WHERE "x".id = "p".id AND ("x".thrombosis <> 0 OR "x".thrombosis IS NULL)) LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "r" ON "r".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "a" ON "a".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND ("r".rbc <= 3.5 OR "r".rbc >= 6.0) AND "a".rnp IN ('1', '4', '15', '16', '64', '256') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday))), 1) AS "average_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp IN ('64', '256')) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday IS NOT NULL AND AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday) < INTERVAL '70 years' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".wbc > 3.5 AND "l".wbc < 9.0 AND ("l".fg <= 150 OR "l".fg >= 450) AND CASE WHEN "l".rnp IN ('0', '1', '4', '15', '16', '64', '256') THEN CAST("l".rnp AS INTEGER) > 15 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M')), 0), 1) AS "women_percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".birthday >= DATE '1936-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1957-01-01' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".cpk >= 250) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".date >= DATE '1981-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1987-01-01' AND "l".date >= "p".birthday AND "l".date < "p".birthday + INTERVAL '50 years' AND "l".plt BETWEEN 100 AND 400 AND "l"."U-PRO" IN ('%%', '1', '2', '3', '4', '30', '100', '300', '>=1000', '>=300', '+1(30)', '+2(100)', 'TR') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(oxygen_count), 4) AS "average_oxygen_atoms_per_molecule" FROM (SELECT "m".molecule_id, COUNT("a".atom_id) AS "oxygen_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM "bond" WHERE bond_type = '-') AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "a".element = 'o' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id) AS "molecule_oxygen_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG(single_bond_count) AS "average_single_bonds_per_molecule" FROM (SELECT "m".molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS "single_bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "b".bond_type = '-' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id) AS "counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(*) AS "atom_occurrences" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' GROUP BY "a".element HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MIN(element_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "element_count" FROM "atom" AS "a2" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m2" ON "m2".molecule_id = "a2".molecule_id WHERE "m2".label = '-' GROUP BY "a2".element) AS "counts") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 'i' THEN "a".atom_id END) AS "iodine_atoms", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 's' THEN "a".atom_id END) AS "sulfur_atoms" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id OR "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id WHERE "a".element IN ('i', 's') AND "b".bond_type = '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "a".element = 'f')) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "molecule" AS "m" WHERE "m".label = '+' LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type, CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS "carcinogenic" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id WHERE "b".molecule_id = 'TR010' GROUP BY "b".bond_type, "m".label ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, "b".bond_type ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT "b".bond_id FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE ("a1".element = 'p' AND "a2".element = 'n') OR ("a1".element = 'n' AND "a2".element = 'p') LIMIT 501
SELECT DISTINCT "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "connected" AS "c" WHERE "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN (SELECT molecule_id FROM "bond" WHERE bond_type = '#' GROUP BY molecule_id) AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id INNER JOIN (SELECT molecule_id FROM "atom" WHERE element IN ('p', 'br') GROUP BY molecule_id) AS "x" ON "x".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'cl') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS "chlorine_percentage" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM "bond" WHERE bond_type = '-') AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'h')::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "fraction", "m".label FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".molecule_id = 'TR006' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id, "m".label LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "bond" AS "b" WHERE "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "b".bond_type <> '-') THEN 'Every bond is single' ELSE 'All other molecules' END AS "molecular_saturation", SUM(CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN 1 WHEN "m".label = '-' THEN -1 ELSE 0 END) AS "carcinogenic_minus_non_carcinogenic" FROM "molecule" AS "m" GROUP BY CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "bond" AS "b" WHERE "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "b".bond_type <> '-') THEN 'Every bond is single' ELSE 'All other molecules' END ORDER BY molecular_saturation ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "carbon_carbon_double_bond_pairs" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "b".bond_type = '=' AND "a1".element = 'c' AND "a2".element = 'c' LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "atom" AS "all_atoms" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m2" ON "m2".molecule_id = "all_atoms".molecule_id WHERE "m2".label = '+'), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id INNER JOIN (SELECT atom_id FROM "connected" UNION ALL SELECT atom_id2 AS "atom_id" FROM "connected") AS "endpoints" ON "endpoints".atom_id = "a".atom_id WHERE "m".label = '+' GROUP BY "a".element HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) = (SELECT MAX(element_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a2".atom_id) AS "element_count" FROM "atom" AS "a2" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m3" ON "m3".molecule_id = "a2".molecule_id INNER JOIN (SELECT atom_id FROM "connected" UNION ALL SELECT atom_id2 AS "atom_id" FROM "connected") AS "endpoints2" ON "endpoints2".atom_id = "a2".atom_id WHERE "m3".label = '+' GROUP BY "a2".element) AS "counts") LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".molecule_id, CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN 'YES' WHEN "m".label = '-' THEN 'NO' END AS "carcinogenic", COUNT("b".bond_id) AS "multiple_bonds" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#') WHERE "a".atom_id = 'TR041_10' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id, "m".label LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE "b".bond_type WHEN '-' THEN 'single' WHEN '=' THEN 'double' WHEN '#' THEN 'triple' END AS "bond_type", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' AND "a1".element = 'c' AND "a2".element = 'c' THEN "b".bond_id END) AS "count" FROM "bond" AS "b" LEFT JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 GROUP BY "b".bond_type ORDER BY CASE "b".bond_type WHEN '-' THEN 1 WHEN '=' THEN 2 WHEN '#' THEN 3 END ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".atom_id2) AS "atom_count" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "chlorine" ON "chlorine".atom_id = "c".atom_id WHERE "chlorine".element = 'cl' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".atom_id2) AS "atom_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "s" ON "s".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "s".atom_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "s".element = 's' LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_id, "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id INNER JOIN (SELECT "a".molecule_id FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN (SELECT element FROM "atom" GROUP BY element HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) = 1) AS "unique_elements" ON "unique_elements".element = "a".element GROUP BY "a".molecule_id) AS "unusual" ON "unusual".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "molecule_count" FROM (SELECT "a".molecule_id FROM "atom" AS "a" LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id LEFT JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id WHERE "a".element = 'n' GROUP BY "a".molecule_id HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#') THEN 1 END) = 0) AS "qualifying_molecules" LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".atom_id2) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "chlorine" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "chlorine".atom_id WHERE "chlorine".element = 'cl' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN "m".molecule_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "m".molecule_id), 0), 2) AS "carcinogenic_percent", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "m".label = '-' THEN "m".molecule_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "m".molecule_id), 0), 2) AS "non_carcinogenic_percent" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '#' LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "c".bond_id) AS "bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN (SELECT element FROM "atom" GROUP BY element HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) = 1) AS "rare" ON "rare".element = "a".element LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id WHERE "m".label = '+' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id ORDER BY "m".molecule_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 'c' THEN "c".bond_id END) DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) DESC, "m".molecule_id ASC) AS "rank", "m".molecule_id, "m".label, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) AS "atom_count", COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "bond_count", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 'c' THEN "a".atom_id END) AS "carbon_count", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 'cl' THEN "a".atom_id END) AS "chlorine_count", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 'c' THEN "c".bond_id END) AS "carbon_touching_bonds", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#') THEN "b".bond_id END) AS "multiple_bonds" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id LEFT JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id GROUP BY "m".molecule_id, "m".label HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 'c' THEN "a".atom_id END) > 0 ORDER BY rank ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".bond_id) AS "bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "y" ON "y".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "y".element = 'y' INNER JOIN "atom" AS "h" ON "h".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "h".element = 'h' INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "h".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "h".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id AND "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(COUNT("c".bond_id)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id), 0), 2) AS "average_bonds_per_atom" FROM "atom" AS "a" LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR397' LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "carbon" ON "carbon".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "m".label = '-' AND "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#') AND "carbon".element = 'c' GROUP BY "a".element LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type, COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "bond_count", COUNT(DISTINCT (LEAST("a1".element, "a2".element), GREATEST("a1".element, "a2".element))) AS "element_pair_count", "m".label FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "b".molecule_id = 'TR377' AND "b".bond_type IN ('-', '=') GROUP BY "b".bond_type, "m".label ORDER BY bond_count DESC, "b".bond_type ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "m".molecule_id FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' AND "a".element IN ('na', 'k', 'ca', 'cu', 'zn', 'sn', 'pb', 'mg', 'li') AND "b".bond_type = '-' ORDER BY "m".molecule_id ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "a".element, COUNT("s".atom_id) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "c".atom_id FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id GROUP BY "c".atom_id HAVING COUNT("b".bond_id) > 0 AND COUNT(CASE WHEN "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#') THEN "b".bond_id END) = 0) AS "s" ON "s".atom_id = "a".atom_id GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY "a".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".molecule_id) AS "molecule_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".element IN (SELECT "a2".element FROM "atom" AS "a2" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a2".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a2".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '#') GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, "a".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "c".bond_id IS NOT NULL THEN "a".atom_id END) AS "bonded_atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR397' GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY "a".element ASC LIMIT 501
